AI.translation: 神经符号（NeSy）系统结合了神经网络与逻辑推理，以实现泛化性与可解释性，但最近的研究表明它们容易产生快捷推理行为。我们提出了一种利用基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程的新方法，以缓解两种现象中的推理快捷方式：约束满足快捷方式（即在未完成预期任务的情况下满足了约束条件）和认知快捷方式（即有偏数据导致尽管逻辑推理正确但概念映射语义错误）。基于最近的基于矩阵的逻辑编程语义，我们引入了缓解快捷方式的设计元素，包括在单个矩阵中统一编码规则和约束。我们还确定了与模糊逻辑t-范数的联系，并实证比较了它们的梯度流特性。通过在MNIST变体上精心设计的实验，我们表明，与先前依赖软概率分布的方法相比，神经网络输出到逻辑原子的一对一接地显著减少了这两种快捷方式类型。随后我们证实，在将符号知识与神经学习耦合时，架构选择在缓解快捷方式方面发挥着关键作用。
AI.summary: 本文针对神经符号系统易受“推理快捷方式”影响的问题，提出了一种基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程方法。该方法在单一矩阵中统一编码规则与约束，并将神经网络输出与逻辑原子进行一对一接地绑定。实验结果表明，该方法相比依赖软概率分布的传统方法能更有效地缓解约束满足快捷方式和认知快捷方式，强调了神经符号架构设计的重要性。
AI.keywords: Neurosymbolic Systems, Differentiable Logic Programming, Reasoning Shortcuts, Constraint Satisfaction Shortcuts, Cognition Shortcuts
AI.comments: 该研究针对神经符号（NeSy）系统容易出现“推理快捷方式”这一关键痛点，创新性地提出了基于矩阵的可微逻辑编程框架，并通过“神经网络输出与逻辑原子的一对一接地”策略替代传统的软概率分布，显著改善了概念映射准确性和梯度流性质。文章在方法设计与理论分析（如统一矩阵编码、模糊逻辑t-范数对比）以及实验验证方面均表现出色，对提高神经符号系统的可靠性与鲁棒性具有重要推动作用。

title: Case study: proving sqrt(2) irrational with LPTP and an LLM
summary: We present the interactions with an LLM (Large Language Model) aiming at proving that the square root of 2 is not a rational number in an LP (Logic Programming) context. We start from a few basic pure logic programming predicate definitions. We rely on the LPTP  (Logic Program Theorem Prover) system for stating and proving properties about logic programs.  As the proof language of LPTP  is based on natural deduction,  the proofs are human readable. In our case study, we sketch in LPTP the usual proof showing the irrationality of the square root of 2.  Then we describe the interactions we had with the LLM. We end up with a complete formal proof, partially generated by an LLM and fully proof-checked by LPTP.

AI.title_translation: 案例研究：利用 LPTP 和大语言模型证明 2 的平方根是无理数
AI.tldr: 通过结合大语言模型（LLM）与基于自然演绎的 LPTP 证明器，成功交互式生成并完全验证了“2的平方根是无理数”的形式化证明。
AI.motivation: 探索在大语言模型（LLM）与逻辑编程定理证明器（LPTP）协同作用下，如何辅助生成既符合人类阅读习惯又具备严格形式化验证的逻辑证明。
AI.method: 基于纯逻辑编程谓词定义，使用基于自然演绎的 LPTP 系统搭建证明草图；通过与大语言模型（LLM）进行交互来补充生成证明细节；最后由 LPTP 系统对包含 LLM 生成部分的完整形式化证明进行自动检查与验证。
AI.result: 成功得到了一个关于“2的平方根是无理数”的完整形式化证明，该证明由 LLM 部分参与生成，并完全通过了 LPTP 的形式化验证。
AI.conclusion: 结合大语言模型与形式化证明器（如 LPTP）能够有效地协作完成兼具可读性与严密性的形式化证明。
AI.translation: 我们展示了在逻辑编程（LP）语境下与大语言模型（LLM）进行交互的过程，旨在证明 2 的平方根不是有理数。我们从几个基础的纯逻辑编程谓词定义出发，依托 LPTP（逻辑程序定理证明器）系统来陈述和证明关于逻辑程序的性质。由于 LPTP 的证明语言基于自然演绎，因此证明具有良好的可读性。在我们的案例研究中，我们在 LPTP 中草拟了展示 2 的平方根无理性的常见证明过程，然后描述了与 LLM 的交互过程。最终，我们得到了一个完整的形式化证明，该证明部分由 LLM 生成，并完全通过了 LPTP 的证明检查。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一项案例研究，展示了在逻辑编程 context 下利用大语言模型（LLM）与 LPTP（逻辑程序定理证明器）交互来证明“2的平方根是无理数”。借助 LPTP 基于自然演绎的可读证明语言，研究者草拟了证明框架并与 LLM 进行交互，最终得到了一个由 LLM 部分生成且经过 LPTP 完全验证的形式化证明。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 形式化证明, 逻辑编程, LPTP, 自然演绎
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将大语言模型与基于自然演绎的逻辑程序定理证明器（LPTP）结合，展示了 AI 辅助形式化推导的可行路径。其亮点在于 LPTP 基于自然演绎使得生成的证明具有人类可读性，同时定理证明器确保了绝对的正确性。局限性在于目前仅针对“2的平方根为无理数”这一单一案例进行了验证，在更复杂、大规模的逻辑程序证明中的扩展性和泛化能力仍有待进一步探究。

title: Identifying Good Rules for Efficient SAT Encodings of Single-Constant Multiplication Using Machine Learning
summary: The Single Constant Multiplication problem is a fundamental NP-hard optimization task in hardware design, which seeks to decompose a fixed constant using only additions, subtractions, and bit-shifts. Although dynamic programming methods can produce near-optimal SAT encodings for SCM, their encoding cost remains high for large constants. We propose a neuro-symbolic framework that accelerates SCM SAT encoding by identifying good rules for guiding operator selection during decomposition. Our approach employs a graph neural network model to predict promising operator types from constant decompositions, and exploits the resulting confidence scores to prune no-good choices in the symbolic search. Experimental results on unseen 17-32 bit constants demonstrate one to two orders of magnitude reductions in encoding time, over 97% reduction in memory usage, and an order-of-magnitude decrease in branching, while preserving near-optimal encoding quality in terms of additions. These results show that learning-guided symbolic strategies can significantly improve the scalability and efficiency of SCM encoding. Our code and data are publicly available at: https://github.com/Chufeng-Jiang/SCM_MLDP

AI.title_translation: 基于机器学习识别高效单常数乘法 SAT 编码的良好规则
AI.tldr: 结合图神经网络与符号搜索剪枝，提出一种加速单常数乘法（SCM）SAT 编码的神经符号框架，大幅降低了大常数编码的时空开销。
AI.motivation: 单常数乘法（SCM）是硬件设计中的 NP-hard 优化任务。虽然动态规划方法能够生成近乎最优的 SAT 编码，但面对大常数时，其编码的时间和内存开销极高，难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出一种神经符号框架，使用图神经网络（GNN）模型预测常数分解中最具潜力的运算符类型，并利用预测的置信度得分对符号搜索空间中的不良选项进行剪枝，从而加速 SCM 的 SAT 编码过程。
AI.result: 在未见过的 17-32 位常数测试中，该方法将编码时间缩短了 1 到 2 个数量级，内存使用量减少了 97% 以上，搜索分支减少了一个数量级，同时保持了近乎最优的加法运算质量。
AI.conclusion: 基于学习引导的符号策略能够显著提升单常数乘法（SCM）SAT 编码的可扩展性和运行效率。
AI.translation: 单常数乘法（SCM）问题是硬件设计中一项基础的 NP-hard 优化任务，旨在仅使用加法、减法和移位来分解固定常数。尽管动态规划方法可以为 SCM 生成近乎最优的 SAT 编码，但对于大常数而言，其编码成本依然高昂。我们提出了一种神经符号框架，通过识别指导分解过程中运算符选择的良好规则来加速 SCM 的 SAT 编码。我们的方法采用图神经网络（GNN）模型从常数分解中预测有前景的运算符类型，并利用得到的置信度得分在符号搜索中剪枝无效选择。在未见过的 17-32 位常数上的实验结果表明，该方法在保持加法运算近乎最优编码质量的同时，将编码时间减少了 1 到 2 个数量级，内存使用量减少了 97% 以上，分支减少了一个数量级。这些结果表明，学习引导的符号策略可以显著提升 SCM 编码的可扩展性和效率。我们的代码和数据已公开发布于：https://github.com/Chufeng-Jiang/SCM_MLDP。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于加速单常数乘法（SCM）SAT 编码的神经符号框架。该方法通过图神经网络预测常数分解时的最佳运算符，并使用预测结果剪枝搜索树。实验表明，该方法在保证近乎最优解的前提下，大幅降低了 17-32 位常数编码的时间和内存开销，显著提高了 SCM 编码的效率和可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 单常数乘法, SAT编码, 图神经网络, 神经符号框架, 机器学习
AI.comments:
创新性：将机器学习（图神经网络）与传统的符号搜索方法相结合（神经符号框架），成功将智能预测应用于 SCM 的 SAT 编码剪枝与优化。
重要性：突破了动态规划在处理大常数 SCM 编码时的时空瓶颈，大幅提升了硬件设计中常数乘法优化的可扩展性与效率。
局限性：实验评估主要集中在 17-32 位常数上，对于更高位宽或更复杂约束下的实际电路应用效果仍有待进一步验证。

title: GLP: A Grassroots, Multiagent, Concurrent, Logic Programming Language for AI
summary:
A grassroots platform is a multiagent distributed system in which multiple independent instances can form and operate independently of each other and of any global resource, yet may coalesce into ever larger instances, possibly resulting in a single global instance.  Grassroots platforms aim to offer an egalitarian/democratic alternative to  centralised/autocratic and decentralised/plutocratic global platforms.
  Here, we present Grassroots Logic Programs (GLP), a multiagent concurrent logic programming language designed for the implementation of grassroots platforms:  we recall the standard operational semantics of logic programs; introduce the concurrent operational semantics of   GLP as its restriction; recall multiagent atomic transactions; use them to introduce a multiagent operational semantics of GLP; and prove multiagent GLP to be grassroots. The grassroots social graph—the foundational grassroots platform on which all others are based—serves as a GLP programming example.

AI.title_translation: GLP：一种用于人工智能的草根、多智能体、并发逻辑编程语言
AI.tldr: 本文提出了GLP（草根逻辑程序），这是一种专为构建平等民主的去中心化草根平台而设计的多智能体并发逻辑编程语言。
AI.motivation: 传统的全球平台往往是集中式/专制式或去中心化/财阀式的，为了提供一种平等且民主的替代方案，需要设计一种能够支持自治且可合并的草根多智能体平台的编程语言。
AI.method: 回顾了逻辑程序的标准运行语义，引入并发运行语义作为约束；进一步结合多智能体原子事务，构建了GLP的多智能体运行语义，并在理论上证明了其草根特性。
AI.result: 成功设计了GLP语言并证明了多智能体GLP具有草根特性，同时以草根社交图谱作为示例展示了GLP的编程应用。
AI.conclusion: GLP为构建民主化、去中心化的草根多智能体平台提供了坚实的逻辑编程基础与理论语义保证。
AI.translation: 草根平台（grassroots platform）是一种多智能体分布式系统，其中多个独立的实例可以相互独立且不依赖任何全局资源地形成和运行，同时又能合并成更大的实例，甚至可能最终形成单一的全球实例。草根平台旨在为集中式/专制式和去中心化/财阀式的全球平台提供一种平等/民主的替代方案。在本文中，我们提出了草根逻辑程序（Grassroots Logic Programs, GLP），这是一种专为实现草根平台而设计的多智能体并发逻辑编程语言：我们回顾了逻辑程序的标准运行语义；将其限制引入为GLP的并发运行语义；回顾了多智能体原子事务；利用它们引入了GLP的多智能体运行语义；并证明了多智能体GLP具有草根特性。草根社交图谱——所有其他草根平台所基于的基础草根平台——被用作GLP的编程示例。
AI.summary: 本文提出了草根逻辑程序（GLP），一种用于实现草根多智能体平台的并发逻辑编程语言。GLP通过结合标准逻辑编程语义与多智能体原子事务，建立了多智能体运行语义。作者理论证明了GLP具有草根特性，并以草根社交图谱展示了其具体应用，为构建民主化的AI分布式平台提供了新工具。
AI.keywords: 草根平台, 多智能体系统, 并发逻辑编程, 运行语义, GLP
AI.comments:
创新性：本文创新性地提出了草根逻辑程序（GLP），将逻辑编程语义与多智能体原子事务结合，为无全局资源依赖的去中心化系统提供了语言层面的理论支撑。
重要性：为构建平等、民主的草根分布式平台提供了全新的编程范式，对于多智能体人工智能系统和去中心化架构的发展具有重要理论价值。
局限性：摘要主要聚焦于理论运行语义的提出和证明，缺乏在复杂真实网络环境下的性能测试与工程落地效果评估。

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning Model for Cross-Modality Super-Resolution in Fluorescence Microscopy
summary: Cross-modality image translation offers a route to super-resolution fluorescence microscopy from low-resolution images while reducing phototoxicity and instrumentation demands. However, purely data-driven models can produce visually plausible outputs that are inconsistent with optical image formation. Here, we propose a physics-informed generative adversarial network for confocal-to-STED image translation that incorporates microscope-specific point spread function information into the training objective. Simulated and experimentally measured PSFs were evaluated using a limited paired confocal-STED dataset of TOM20-labeled mitochondria in human primary M2 macrophages acquired across different experimental days. Performance was assessed using reference-based and non-reference-based image-quality metrics, together with complementary frequency- and distribution-sensitive analyses. The no-reference metrics probed physics-relevant image properties, including spatial-frequency content, contrast, and signal-to-noise behavior. PSF-guided models improved structural fidelity, reduced local deviations, and achieved closer agreement with STED references than non-PSF baselines, particularly in frequency-domain analyses. These results demonstrate that optical priors can improve the structural fidelity and physical plausibility of generative microscopy models for cross-modality super-resolution imaging.

AI.title_translation: 荧光显微镜中跨模态超分辨率的物理知情深度学习模型
AI.tldr: 一种将点扩散函数（PSF）光学先验融入生成对抗网络的物理知情深度学习模型，实现了高结构保真度、符合物理成像规律的共聚焦到STED图像跨模态超分辨率重建。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的图像翻译模型容易生成看似合理但违背光学成像物理规律的超分辨率图像，缺乏物理保真度。
AI.method: 提出了一种结合特定显微镜点扩散函数（PSF）的物理知情生成对抗网络（GAN），用于共聚焦到STED图像的超分辨率翻译；利用有限的线粒体成对图像数据集，对模拟及实测PSF指导的模型进行训练，并结合参考与无参考（包含空间频率、对比度、信噪比等物理属性）指标进行多维性能评估。
AI.result: PSF引导的物理知情模型在结构保真度上表现更好，局部偏差显著减少，在频域分析和无参考质量评估中与真实的STED参考图像显示出更高的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将光学物理先验融入生成式显微成像深度学习模型中，可有效改善跨模态超分辨率重建的结构保真度与物理一致性。
AI.translation: 跨模态图像翻译提供了一条从低分辨率图像实现荧光显微超分辨率的途径，同时降低了光毒性和对仪器设备的要求。然而，纯数据驱动的模型可能会产生视觉上合理但与光学成像过程不一致的输出。在此，我们提出了一种用于共聚焦到STED图像翻译的物理知情生成对抗网络，该网络将特定显微镜的点扩散函数（PSF）信息融入到训练目标中。我们使用跨不同实验天采集的人类原代M2巨噬细胞中TOM20标记线粒体的有限成对共聚焦-STED数据集，对模拟和实验测量的PSF进行了评估。通过基于参考和无参考的图像质量指标，以及互补的频率和分布敏感分析来评估性能。无参考指标探测了与物理相关的图像属性，包括空间频率内容、对比度和信噪比特性。PSF引导的模型提高了结构保真度，减少了局部偏差，并且比非PSF基线模型更接近STED参考图像，特别是在频域分析中。这些结果表明，光学先验可以提高生成式显微镜模型在跨模态超分辨率成像中的结构保真度和物理合理性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于共聚焦到STED显微图像翻译的物理知情生成对抗网络。该模型将显微镜的点扩散函数（PSF）物理先验引入训练目标，克服了传统纯数据驱动模型生成不符合光学物理规律图像的缺陷。实验表明，物理先验的加入显著提升了超分辨率图像的结构保真度和频域一致性。
AI.keywords: 物理知情深度学习, 跨模态图像翻译, 超分辨率显微术, 点扩散函数, 生成对抗网络
AI.comments: 本文巧妙地将光学成像的物理机制（PSF点扩散函数）融入深度学习模型的损失函数中，有效地解决了纯数据驱动超分辨率模型容易产生不符合物理规律的幻觉伪影问题。论文通过结合参考与非参考（频域/信噪比等）多维度评估，证明了光学先验在小样本训练下对提升重建图像真实性和物理合理性的关键作用。

title: Encoding Event-B Proof Rules in Prolog: An Interactive Sequent Prover for ProB
summary: Event-B is a formal method rooted in predicate logic and set theory. We encoded over 600 proof rules in Prolog, enabling a systematic, comprehensible proof analysis and construction. By integrating the proof rules into the Prolog-based validation tool ProB, we obtain an interactive proof system with proof tree visualisation. This has advantages in teaching, giving students direct control over the selection of proof rules. Our tool can import proof obligations from the Rodin platform and provides multiple exports: a trace file for proof replay in ProB, an interactive HTML document for tool-independent exploration of the proof tree, and an export back to Rodin, allowing the ProB prover to be used as second chain. Compared to the previous implementation of the proof rules in Java, the encoding in Prolog is more compact, maintainable and extensible. While a preliminary iterative deepening prover with simple heuristics is already available and useful for finding short proofs, we aim to obtain fast automatic provers in the future.

AI.title_translation: 在Prolog中编码Event-B证明规则：用于ProB的交互式序列证明器
AI.tldr: 本文在Prolog中编码了600多个Event-B证明规则，为ProB开发了一个具备证明树可视化、易维护且支持与Rodin平台无缝集成的交互式序列证明器。
AI.motivation: 针对之前在Java中实现Event-B证明规则导致的代码冗长、难以维护和扩展的问题，以及为了提供更适合教学的直观交互式证明系统和增强与Rodin平台的互操作性，提出在Prolog中编码证明规则。
AI.method:
1. 在Prolog中对600多个Event-B证明规则进行形式化编码。
2. 将编码后的规则集成到基于Prolog的ProB验证工具中，构建具备证明树可视化功能的交互式序列证明器。
3. 实现与Rodin平台的双向集成：支持导入Rodin的证明义务（PO），并支持导出ProB重放轨迹文件、交互式HTML文档以及回导至Rodin。
4. 结合简单启发式策略，开发初步的迭代加深证明器以寻找短证明。
AI.result:
1. 实现了基于ProB的交互式证明系统，具备良好的证明树可视化效果，方便教学使用。
2. 相比原有的Java实现，Prolog编码更加紧凑、易于维护和扩展。
3. 成功实现了多格式导出与Rodin平台的双向集成。
4. 提供了初步可用的迭代加深证明器，能够有效寻找较短的证明。
AI.conclusion: 在Prolog中编码Event-B证明规则极大地提升了ProB证明系统的扩展性与可维护性，不仅改善了交互式教学与验证体验，也为未来开发高性能自动证明器奠定了坚实基础。
AI.translation: Event-B是一种根植于谓词逻辑和集合论的形式化方法。我们在Prolog中编码了600多个证明规则，从而能够进行系统化、易于理解的证明分析与构建。通过将这些证明规则集成到基于Prolog的验证工具ProB中，我们获得了一个带有证明树可视化的交互式证明系统。这在教学中具有优势，使学生能够直接控制证明规则的选择。我们的工具可以从Rodin平台导入证明义务，并提供多种导出方式：用于在ProB中重放证明的轨迹文件、用于独立于工具探索证明树的交互式HTML文档，以及导出回Rodin，从而允许将ProB证明器用作第二链。与之前在Java中实现证明规则相比，Prolog中的编码更加紧凑、易于维护和扩展。虽然目前已经提供了一个带有简单启发式策略的初步迭代加深证明器，且可用于寻找较短的证明，但我们的目标是在未来获得快速的自动证明器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个在Prolog中编码600多个Event-B证明规则并集成至ProB工具的交互式序列证明器。该系统支持证明树可视化，在教学中赋予学生直接选择证明规则的能力。系统还实现了与Rodin平台的无缝集成，支持多种导出格式。相比以往的Java实现，Prolog编码更紧凑、易维护，并为未来实现高效自动证明奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: Event-B, Prolog, ProB, 交互式证明器, 证明规则
AI.comments:
创新点：巧妙利用Prolog声明式逻辑编程语言的特性来编码Event-B的600多个证明规则，显著提高了代码的紧凑度与可维护性，并实现了与Rodin平台的良好双向对接。
实用价值：在形式化方法教学中具有显著优势，能够直观展示证明树并让学生手动控制规则选择；同时为ProB提供了二次验证能力。
局限性：目前仅配备了基于简单启发式策略的初步迭代加深证明器，全自动证明能力和求解速度仍有提升空间。

title: Animation, Verification and Visualisation of Prolog Transition Systems with ProB
summary: ProB is a Prolog-based model checker, animator and constraint solver for high-level formal specifications. One can also use ProB to animate transition systems defined by Prolog predicates, allowing the application of its various validation techniques. In this work, we present the existing features of ProB's Prolog animation mode and its recent extensions. The extended capabilities include simulation for statistical checks, more reliable trace replay, transitions with user input and improved state visualisation. We apply the new features to case studies, particularly for evaluating different strategies in game play, such as Connect Four. The features are useful for many other applications, especially for ProB's new sequent prover for Event-B proof obligations, as well as for demonstration models for teaching in combination with interactive visualisation.

AI.title_translation: 基于ProB的Prolog迁移系统的动画演示、验证与可视化
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ProB在Prolog迁移系统中的增强动画模式，新增了统计模拟、跟踪重放、交互迁移和可视化优化，并应用于游戏策略评估与教学。
AI.motivation: 为了更好地利用ProB对Prolog谓词定义的迁移系统进行动画演示和验证，需要对其现有动画模式进行功能扩展，以支持更丰富的分析手段、用户交互和教学演示需求。
AI.method: 展示并增强了ProB的Prolog动画模式，引入了用于统计检查的仿真模拟、更可靠的跟踪重放、支持用户输入的迁移转换以及改进的状态可视化技术，并通过案例研究进行验证。
AI.result: 成功将新功能应用于案例研究（如四子棋游戏的策略评估），并证实这些功能在ProB的Event-B新序列证明器以及教学演示模型中具有极高实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 扩展后的ProB Prolog动画模式显著增强了其分析和可视化能力，成功应用于棋类游戏策略评估，并在Event-B证明和交互式教学中表现出广泛的应用价值。
AI.translation: ProB是一个基于Prolog的模型检查器、动画器和约束求解器，用于高级形式化规范。人们也可以使用ProB来动态演示由Prolog谓词定义的迁移系统，从而能够应用其各种验证技术。在这项工作中，我们介绍了ProB的Prolog动画模式的现有功能及其最新的扩展。扩展的功能包括用于统计检查的模拟、更可靠的跟踪重放、带有用户输入的迁移以及改进的状态可视化。我们将这些新功能应用于案例研究，特别是用于评估棋类游戏（如四子棋）中的不同策略。这些功能对许多其他应用也十分有用，特别是对于ProB用于Event-B证明义务的新序列证明器，以及结合交互式可视化的教学示范模型。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了形式化验证工具ProB在Prolog迁移系统动画模式下的增强功能，包括统计检查模拟、跟踪重放、交互式迁移和状态可视化优化。通过四子棋等案例研究展示了其在策略评估、Event-B证明及教学中的应用。
AI.keywords: ProB, Prolog, 迁移系统, 模型检查, 可视化
AI.comments: 本文创新性地扩展了ProB在Prolog迁移系统中的分析与交互能力，将形式化验证工具与统计模拟、用户交互及可视化有效结合，不仅拓展了其在游戏策略评估等实际案例中的应用，还为教学演示和Event-B定理证明提供了强有力的工具 stöd。局限性在于摘要未提及这些扩展功能在大规模复杂系统下的性能和计算开销。

title: What Bugs Do Prolog Students Write? An Empirical Taxonomy and Data-Driven Mutation Framework
summary: Automated feedback tools for logic programming education depend on realistic bug datasets that reflect the mistakes students actually make. However, existing mutation testing frameworks for Prolog treat all mutations as equally likely, producing synthetic faults that diverge from classroom reality. We present an empirical study of 7,201 Prolog submissions from 265 undergraduate students, from which we derive a fine-grained taxonomy of student bugs through manual classification of 200 bug-fixing submissions. Guided by this taxonomy, we develop LogMorph, a data-driven mutation tool whose 17 operators are weighted according to the observed error distribution. LogMorph enumerates valid mutation sites on the abstract syntax tree, samples operators proportionally, injects faults, delegating to an SMT-based synthesizer when new code fragments are needed, and validates each mutant against a reference test suite. An evaluation of 16,000 generated mutants shows that the synthetic error distribution closely matches the student distribution, with most bug categories agreeing to within two percentage points. We identify cut-related mutations and synthesizer-generated code as the main sources of residual divergence, and outline how combining the SMT back-end with a language model fine-tuned on student code can further improve realism.

AI.title_translation: Prolog 学生会写出哪些 Bug？实证分类法与数据驱动的变异框架
AI.tldr: 通过对 Prolog 学生代码进行实证分析建立错误分类法，并开发了数据驱动且能高度还原真实学生错误分布的变异工具 LogMorph。
AI.motivation: 逻辑编程教育中的自动化反馈工具依赖真实的学生错误数据集，但现有的 Prolog 变异测试框架将所有变异视为等概率发生，生成的合成错误与现实课堂情况不符。
AI.method: 分析 265 名本科生的 7,201 份 Prolog 提交作业，通过人工归类 200 份修复提交构建错误分类法；基于此开发数据驱动的变异工具 LogMorph，包含 17 个按观察到的错误分布加权的算子；通过在 AST 上列举变异点、按比例采样算子注入错误、使用 SMT 合成器生成新代码片段，并利用参考测试集验证变异体。
AI.result: 对生成的 16,000 个变异体进行评估显示，合成错误分布与学生实际错误分布高度匹配，大多数错误类别的偏差在 2 个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: LogMorph 能够成功生成高度贴近真实学生错误分布的 Prolog 变异体，主要偏差源于剪切变异和代码合成，结合 LLM 可进一步提高真实性。
AI.translation: 逻辑编程教育中的自动化反馈工具依赖于能反映学生实际错误的真实 Bug 数据集。然而，现有的 Prolog 变异测试框架将所有变异视为等概率发生，从而产生了偏离课堂实际情况的合成错误。本文对来自 265 名本科生的 7,201 份 Prolog 提交作业进行了实证研究，并通过对 200 份修复错误提交的人工分类，得出了学生 Bug 的细粒度分类法。在这一分类法的指导下，我们开发了数据驱动的变异工具 LogMorph，其 17 个算子根据观察到的错误分布进行了加权。LogMorph 在抽象语法树（AST）上列举有效的变异位置，按比例对算子进行采样并注入错误，在需要新的代码片段时委托给基于 SMT 的合成器，并通过参考测试套件对每个变异体进行验证。对 16,000 个生成的变异体的评估表明，合成错误分布与学生错误分布高度匹配，大多数错误类别的吻合度在两个百分点以内。我们确定了与剪切符号（cut）相关的变异和合成器生成的代码是残余偏差的主要来源，并概述了将 SMT 后端与在学生代码上微调的语言模型相结合如何进一步提高真实性。
AI.summary: 本文针对 Prolog 教学中缺乏真实学生错误数据集的问题，分析了 7,201 份学生作业并构建了学生错误分类法，进而开发了数据驱动的变异工具 LogMorph。该工具通过按真实错误分布加权变异算子并结合 SMT 代码合成，成功合成了分布与真实学生错误高度一致的变异体。
AI.keywords: Prolog 编程教育, 错误分类法, 变异测试, LogMorph, SMT 合成
AI.comments: 该研究针对 Prolog 逻辑编程教学中变异测试与学生实际错误偏离的问题，通过真实学生作业数据构建了具体的错误分类法，并开发了数据驱动的变异工具 LogMorph。其创新点在于结合真实分布权重与基于 SMT 的代码合成技术，极大提升了生成变异体的真实性。局限性在于剪切符号（cut）相关变异和合成器生成的代码仍存在一定偏差，未来可结合针对学生代码微调的大语言模型进一步改善。

title: Chess\_db: A framework for working with large chess game datasets
summary: Chess is a two player strategic game that is embedded in classical AI  culture as it was once the frontier for intelligent behaviour.  There was the silent assumption that the advent of computer engines that  play better than the best humans will extinguish interest in the game. However, the opposite has come to pass, with a growing following for the game. A lot of the computational resources are now centered around training of players, where the engine output is just one aspect. Access to  past games is also an essential part, both in knowing what games a specific player has played previously, and also which continuations at a certain position have led to victory more often for each of the two colour players. We present Chess_db a suite of logic programming tools that can effectively manipulate games both in memory and via creating back end databases.  In particular, we provide versatile code that creates databases from PGN (portable game notation) game files and explore the suitability of open source key-value databases for  storing position tables that provide near-instant access to  information pertaining to substantially large number of games.

AI.title_translation: Chess_db：用于处理大型国际象棋对局数据集的框架
AI.tldr: Chess_db 是一个利用逻辑编程和开源键值数据库高效存储并秒级检索海量国际象棋对局与局势信息的系统框架。
AI.motivation: 现代国际象棋训练高度依赖对历史对局及特定局势后续胜率的分析，需要一种能够高效存储和极速检索海量对局数据的系统工具。
AI.method: 提出了 Chess_db 工具套件，采用逻辑编程处理内存中的对局数据并构建后端数据库；开发了从 PGN 格式文件提取数据并存入开源键值数据库的代码，构建局势索引表。
AI.result: 实现了从 PGN 文件自动生成数据库，利用开源键值数据库实现了对海量对局中特定局势及相关信息的近乎瞬时（near-instant）快速查询。
AI.conclusion: 结合逻辑编程与开源键值数据库的 Chess_db 框架，为处理和快速检索大规模国际象棋对局及局势数据提供了切实高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 国际象棋是一种双人战略游戏，作为曾经智能行为的前沿领域而深刻植根于经典人工智能文化中。人们曾默认为，棋艺超越人类顶尖棋手的计算机引擎的出现将抹杀人们对这项游戏的兴趣。然而事实恰恰相反，该游戏的受众群体正日益壮大。如今大量计算资源集中于棋手的训练，而引擎输出仅是其中一个方面。获取历史对局同样是不可或缺的一部分，这既包括了解特定棋手以往参加过的比赛，也包括了解在特定局势下的哪种后续着法更容易为双方棋手带来胜利。我们推出了 Chess_db，这是一套逻辑编程工具，能够有效地在内存中以及通过创建后端数据库来操作对局。具体而言，我们提供了多功能的代码，可从 PGN（便携式对局记号）对局文件中创建数据库，并探讨了开源键值数据库在存储局势表方面的适用性，这些局势表能够为涉及极大数量对局的相关信息提供近乎瞬时的检索访问。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Chess_db，这是一个专为处理大规模国际象棋数据集而设计的逻辑编程框架。该框架能够解析 PGN 格式的对局文件，并利用开源键值数据库存储局势表，从而实现对海量历史对局和着法数据的极速检索，满足现代国际象棋训练与分析的数据需求。
AI.keywords: 国际象棋, 数据集框架, 逻辑编程, 键值数据库, PGN格式
AI.comments:
创新性：将逻辑编程工具与开源键值数据库巧妙结合，专门用于国际象棋局势检索，思路清晰且针对性强。
重要性：在国际象棋训练日益依赖海量历史数据分析的背景下，为对局存储和快速查询提供了实用高效的技术方案。
局限性：摘要中缺乏具体数据库选型及定量性能对比数据（如检索延迟或并发吞吐量）。

title: Case study: solving P-99 with LPTP and an LLM
summary: Ninety-Nine Prolog Problems (P-99) is a famous set of Prolog exercises. We solved the first thirty three just by prompting an LLM (Large Language Model). We used Claude from Anthropic. By solved we mean: generate the Prolog code and a test file, run the tests and check whether they pass, then formally prove types, groundness, termination, uniqueness, existence and also sometimes functional correctness with LPTP (Logic Program Theorem Prover). Hence our approach is an experiment in vibe-coding/vericoding of P-99. It is a vibe-coding experiment because we started from informal specifications written in English and let Claude generate the Prolog code. It also fits within vericoding because the LLM proved reliability guarantees on the generated Prolog code. Claude wrote 58 logic procedures, 508 tests, 257 lemmas for a total of 11800 proof lines. We manually checked each file generated by the LLM. We checked the Prolog code, ran the tests, examined the logical statements generated by Claude and proof-checked Claude's proofs with LPTP. This paper describes this experiment and provides the main details so that it can be reproduced by the interested reader.

AI.title_translation: 案例研究：结合 LPTP 与大语言模型解决 P-99 问题
AI.tldr: 本文通过提示 Claude 模型生成 Prolog 代码及测试集，并利用 LPTP 定理证明器生成万行证明代码，成功以形式化验证的方式解决了前 33 个 P-99 问题。
AI.motivation: 探索利用大语言模型（LLM）从非形式化自然语言描述中生成代码（vibe-coding），并结合形式化定理证明器（LPTP）验证代码的可靠性与正确性（vericoding），以评估 LLM 在逻辑编程与形式化验证领域的潜力。
AI.method: 通过提示 Anthropic 的 Claude 模型，根据英文非形式化规范自动生成 Prolog 代码及测试文件并运行测试；随后利用 Claude 使用 LPTP（逻辑程序定理证明器）生成关于类型、Groundness、终止性、唯一性、存在性及功能正确性的形式化证明；最后由研究人员手动审查代码与逻辑声明，并使用 LPTP 验证生成的 11800 行证明代码。
AI.result: 成功解决了 P-99 集合中的前 33 个问题。Claude 共生成了 58 个逻辑过程、508 个测试用例、257 个引理以及 11800 行证明代码，所有生成成果均通过了测试和 LPTP 的形式化证明检查。
AI.conclusion: 结合大语言模型（Claude）与形式化定理证明器（LPTP）可以有效实现从自然语言需求到具备严密可靠性保证（类型、终止性、正确性等）的 Prolog 代码生成，证明了结合 vibe-coding 和 vericoding 的可行性与可复现性。
AI.translation: 99 个 Prolog 问题（P-99）是一套著名的 Prolog 练习题。我们仅通过提示大语言模型（LLM）就解决了其中的前 33 个问题。我们使用的是 Anthropic 的 Claude。我们所谓的“解决”是指：生成 Prolog 代码和测试文件，运行测试并检查其是否通过，然后使用 LPTP（逻辑程序定理证明器）形式化证明其类型、Groundness、终止性、唯一性、存在性以及有时包含功能正确性。因此，我们的方法是对 P-99 进行“氛编码/验证编码”（vibe-coding/vericoding）的一次实验。这属于 vibe-coding 实验，因为我们从英文的非形式化规范开始，让 Claude 生成 Prolog 代码；它也符合 vericoding，因为 LLM 证明了所生成 Prolog 代码的可靠性保证。Claude 编写了 58 个逻辑过程、508 个测试用例、257 个引理，总计 11800 行证明代码。我们手动检查了 LLM 生成的每一个文件，检查了 Prolog 代码，运行了测试，审查了 Claude 生成的逻辑声明，并使用 LPTP 对 Claude 的证明进行了证明检查。本文描述了该实验并提供了主要细节，以便有兴趣的读者可以复现。
AI.summary: 本案例研究探索了使用大语言模型 Claude 解决经典 Prolog 练习集 P-99 前 33 个问题的方法。研究者采用结合“氛围编码”（从自然语言生成代码）与“验证编码”（通过定理证明器进行验证）的策略，不仅让 Claude 自动生成 Prolog 代码和测试文件，还利用形式化定理证明器 LPTP 生成并验证了包含类型、终止性和正确性等特性的 11800 行形式化证明，所有结果均通过了人工与系统的双重检验。
AI.keywords: P-99, 大语言模型 (LLM), Prolog, LPTP, 形式化验证 (vericoding)
AI.comments: 论文巧妙地将大语言模型（LLM）代码生成的便捷性（vibe-coding）与逻辑程序形式化验证（vericoding）相结合，开辟了自动编程与形式化方法融合的新思路。通过让 LLM 亲自编写高达万行的证明代码并通过定理证明器验证，显著提高了 AI 生成代码的可信度。不过研究范围仅涵盖前 33 个相对基础的问题，且包含人工复核环节，如何在更大规模、更复杂的实际项目中实现全自动化验证仍有待进一步探索。

title: Declarative Problem Solving in UAM Strategic Deconfliction
summary: The growing demand for Urban Air Mobility (UAM) introduces significant challenges in airspace management, particularly within densely populated metropolitan regions. As the number of aerial vehicles-such as drones, air taxis, and helicopters-continues to rise, so does the risk of mid-air collisions and conflicts with existing air traffic and obstacles. Ensuring safe and efficient UAM operations requires robust strategic deconfliction mechanisms. We propose an Answer Set Programming (ASP) based approach for strategic deconfliction, focusing on time synchronization and route optimization for conflict-free flight plans. The solution is benchmarked against Constraint Programming (CP), emphasizing scalability and resource use. Results show that ASP offers faster execution and better scalability for small to medium cases, while CP maintains stable memory but degrades with complexity.

AI.title_translation: 城市空中交通战略解冲突中的声明式问题求解
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于回答集编程（ASP）的UAM战略解冲突方法，在中小规模案例中比约束编程（CP）速度更快、扩展性更好。
AI.motivation: 随着无人机、空中出租车等城市空中交通（UAM）需求的快速增长，密集空域中的空中碰撞及障碍物冲突风险显著增加，急需强健的战略解冲突机制以保障安全高效运行。
AI.method: 提出了基于回答集编程（ASP）的声明式战略解冲突求解方法，重点进行飞行计划的时间同步与路径优化。同时引入约束编程（CP）作为基准，对比分析了两种方法在可扩展性和资源消耗方面的表现。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，ASP在中小规模求解案例中执行速度更快且可扩展性更好；CP虽然能保持较稳定的内存占用，但其性能随着问题复杂度的增加而明显退化。
AI.conclusion: 声明式编程（特别是ASP）能够为城市空中交通提供高效的战略解冲突能力，在中小规模飞行计划优化中具备显著的计算速度与可扩展性优势。
AI.translation: 城市空中交通（UAM）日益增长的需求给空域管理带来了重大挑战，特别是在人口稠密的大都市地区。随着无人机、空中出租车和直升机等航空器数量的持续增加，空中碰撞以及与现有空中交通和障碍物发生冲突的风险也随之上升。确保安全高效的 UAM 运行需要强健的战略解冲突机制。我们提出了一种基于回答集编程（ASP）的战略解冲突方法，重点关注时间同步和路径优化，以制定无冲突的飞行计划。该解决方案以约束编程（CP）为基准进行了对比，重点评估了可扩展性和资源消耗。结果表明，对于中小规模的案例，ASP 提供了更快的执行速度和更好的可扩展性，而 CP 虽然保持了稳定的内存占用，但其性能随着复杂度的增加而退化。
AI.summary: 本文针对城市空中交通（UAM）的空域管理难题，提出了一种基于回答集编程（ASP）的战略解冲突与航线优化方法。通过与约束编程（CP）的性能对比，验证了ASP在中小规模场景下具有更快的计算速度和更优的可扩展性，为UAM安全飞行计划的生成提供了有效的解题思路。
AI.keywords: 城市空中交通, 战略解冲突, 回答集编程, 约束编程, 路径优化
AI.comments:
创新性：将逻辑声明式编程（ASP）引入城市空中交通（UAM）这一新兴交通领域的战略解冲突与航线规划中，拓展了声明式求解器的应用场景。
重要性：随着无人机和空中出租车的普及，高效无冲突的航线规划对未来大都市空域安全至关重要。
局限性：根据实验对比，ASP在应对极高复杂度和大规模场景时可能面临内存或性能瓶颈，如何在大规模实时场景中保持优势仍需进一步探索。

title: Walk-In Multi-Stage Patient Flow Scheduling: An ASP Model with DES-Based Evaluation
summary: An effective examination and test schedule for patients plays a crucial role in hospital resource management. In this work, we formulate a new reactive patient-flow scheduling problem in multi-department hospitals where walk-in patients arrive over time and each patient requires multiple examinations per visit. Upon each arrival, the scheduler computes a feasible examination pathway-both the sequence of examinations and the room assignment-for the incoming patient only, while previously scheduled assignments remain fixed. This process is subject to medical precedence constraints and room capacity limitations. We model the problem declaratively in Answer Set Programming (ASP) with clingo, and optimize a two-part cost: travel time between consecutive examination locations and queue-induced waiting time, weighted by the duration of the upcoming examination. To assess robustness under stochastic service times, we propose a Discrete-Event Simulation (DES) evaluation layer and a baseline greedy policy for comparison. On large-scale synthetic datasets across various capacity regimes and patient loads, the ASP approach reduces median stay time and increases the proportion of zero-wait patients compared to DES-based baselines. These improvements are most pronounced under heavy load, while the approach still outperforms baselines across all capacity settings, with smaller gains at higher capacities.

AI.title_translation: 步入式多阶段患者流调度：一种具有基于DES评估的ASP模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于回答集编程（ASP）和离散事件模拟（DES）的响应式患者流调度模型，显著降低了医院步入式患者的排队等待与停留时间。
AI.motivation: 多科室医院中步入式患者随时间动态到达且需要进行多次检查，如何在满足医学优先级和诊室容量约束的前提下，优化移动时间与排队等待时间，是医院资源管理中的关键挑战。
AI.method:
1. 将步入式患者调度建模为响应式问题：新患者到达时仅为其计算检查顺序和诊室分配，已有调度保持不变；
2. 使用 Answer Set Programming (ASP) 及 clingo 求解器进行声明式建模，优化由移动时间和加权排队等待时间构成的成本函数；
3. 构建基于离散事件模拟（DES）的评估层和贪婪基线策略，以评估在随机服务时间下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在大规模合成数据集上的实验表明，相比基于DES的贪婪基线，ASP方法显著降低了患者的中位数停留时间，并提高了零等待患者的比例。该提升在重负载条件下最为明显，且在各种容量设置下均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 基于ASP的响应式调度方法结合DES评估，能够显著提升医院多阶段患者流的调度效率与鲁棒性，尤其在患者负载较重、资源紧张的场景下效果尤为显著。
AI.translation: 有效的患者检查和测试调度在医院资源管理中起着至关重要作用。在本文中，我们针对多科室医院提出了一种新的响应式患者流调度问题，其中步入式患者随时间陆续到达，且每位患者每次就诊都需要接受多次检查。每当有新患者到达时，调度程序仅为该新到患者计算一条可行的检查路径（包括检查顺序和诊室分配），而先前已调度的分配保持不变。该过程受制于医学优先顺序约束和诊室容量限制。我们在回答集编程（ASP）中使用 clingo 对该问题进行了声明式建模，并优化了一个由两部分组成的成本：连续检查地点之间的移动时间，以及由下一次检查时长加权的排队等待时间。为了评估在随机服务时间下的鲁棒性，我们提出了一个离散事件模拟（DES）评估层以及一个用于比较的贪婪策略基准。在涵盖不同容量机制和患者负载的大规模合成数据集上，与基于DES的基线相比，ASP方法减少了中位数停留时间，并提高了零等待患者的比例。这些改善在重负载下最为显著，同时该方法在所有容量设置下均优于基线，但在较高容量时增益较小。
AI.summary: 本文针对医院多科室步入式患者的多阶段检查调度问题，提出了一种基于回答集编程（ASP）的响应式调度模型，旨在优化患者移动时间和等待时间。同时，结合离散事件模拟（DES）评估模型在不确定服务时间下的鲁棒性。实验结果证明，该方法在降低患者停留时间和提升零等待比例方面均优于贪婪基线策略，特别是在高负载场景下表现突出。
AI.keywords: 回答集编程, 患者流调度, 离散事件模拟, 响应式调度, 医院资源管理
AI.comments: 本研究将声明式编程工具（ASP/clingo）创新性地应用于多科室医院的动态步入式患者流调度，结合离散事件模拟（DES）评估随机服务时间下的鲁棒性，兼具理论创新与实用价值。其响应式机制既保证了实时性，又维持了既有调度的稳定性。不足之处在于目前仅在合成数据集上进行了验证，未来可进一步在真实医院数据和场景中检验其有效性。

title: Towards a Certifying Grounder
summary:
Grounding, the translation of high-level theories into equivalent quantifier-free formulas, is a crucial step in declarative solving, yet it has so far escaped the proof-logging revolution. When this grounding step is not certifying, there is no way of knowing that the obtained solutions actually correspond to the original problem specification, resulting in a trust gap. 
  In this paper, we close the trust gap between the user's high-level specification and the solver's low-level input by introducing a novel certifying grounding framework for first-order logic model expansion (FOX) over finite domains. We present CertiFOX, a framework consisting of: (1) a proof format for grounding derivations, (2) GroundFOX, a certifying grounder operating on theories in Grounding Normal Form (GNF)--a new normal form designed for compact, domain-aware grounding--and (3) CheckFOX, an independent proof checker.
  Our approach guarantees that the grounder's output is equivalent to the input specification, setting the stage for trustworthy end-to-end certified solving pipelines for declarative languages. Experimental evaluation confirms that CertiFOX is a feasible approach. The GroundFOX grounder is broadly comparable with other grounders, and proof checking with CheckFOX adds overhead within a small constant factor of grounding time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个可认证接地框架 CertiFOX，通过提供证明格式、接地器 GroundFOX 和检查器 CheckFOX，弥合了高层规范与解算器输入之间的信任鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 接地（Grounding）是将高层声明式规范转换为无量词公式的关键步骤，但现有接地器缺乏证明记录（proof-logging）机制。未经认证的接地过程可能导致解算器求得的解与原始问题不匹配，产生信任鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出了用于有限域一阶逻辑模型扩展（FOX）的可认证接地框架 CertiFOX，包含三部分：(1) 一套针对接地推导的证明格式；(2) GroundFOX，一种基于新型接地范式（GNF）运行的可认证接地器；(3) CheckFOX，一个独立的证明检查器。
AI.result: 实验评估表明 CertiFOX 具有实用可行性：GroundFOX 的接地效率与其他通用接地器相当，而 CheckFOX 进行证明检查带来的时间开销仅为接地时间的较小常数倍。
AI.conclusion: CertiFOX 框架确保接地器的输出与原始输入规范在逻辑上完全等价，成功为声明式求解语言构建端到端可信认证管道奠定了关键基础。
AI.translation: 接地（Grounding）是将高层理论转换为等价的无量词公式的过程，是声明式求解中的关键步骤，但迄今为止尚未融入证明记录（proof-logging）的变革中。当接地步骤不可认证时，无法确定获得的解是否确实对应原始问题规范，从而导致信任鸿沟。在本文中，我们通过引入一种针对有限域上的一阶逻辑模型扩展（FOX）的新型可认证接地框架，填补了用户的极高层规范与解算器的低层输入之间的信任鸿沟。我们提出了 CertiFOX，该框架包含：(1) 用于接地推导的证明格式，(2) GroundFOX，一个基于接地范式（GNF，一种专为紧凑且感知论域的接地而设计的全新范式）运行的可认证接地器，以及 (3) CheckFOX，一个独立的证明检查器。我们的方法保证了接地器的输出与输入规范等价，为声明式语言建立可信的端到端认证求解管道奠定了基础。实验评估确认了 CertiFOX 是一种可行的方法。GroundFOX 接地器与其他接地器广具可比性，而使用 CheckFOX 进行证明检查所增加的开销控制在接地时间的较小常数倍以内。
AI.summary: 本文针对声明式求解中接地阶段缺乏认证的问题，提出了 CertiFOX 框架。该框架通过定义接地推导证明格式、设计基于接地范式（GNF）的可认证接地器 GroundFOX，以及提供独立的证明检查器 CheckFOX，实现了接地过程的完全可信认证，且性能与现有接地工具相当。
AI.keywords: Grounding, Certifying Grounder, First-Order Logic, Model Expansion, Proof-logging
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将“证明记录（Proof-logging）”与“可认证计算”引入到声明式求解中的接地（Grounding）阶段，填补了高层规范与底层逻辑解算器之间的信任鸿沟。提出的接地范式（GNF）和三位一体框架（证明格式、接地器、检查器）兼顾了理论严谨性与实用效率，为实现完全可信的端到端约束求解管道做出了重要贡献。局限性在于目前主要针对有限域一阶逻辑模型扩展（FOX），推广到更复杂的声明式语言可能需要进一步扩展其范式与证明格式。

title: Bound-Founded Semantics for Answer Set Programming with Difference Constraints: Preliminary Report
summary: While the integration of linear constraints has significantly expanded the reach of Answer Set Programming (ASP), existing hybrid solvers often rely on disparate semantic underpinnings that lack a unified logical foundation. We address this gap by introducing a many-sorted variant of the Bound-founded Logic of Here-and-There (HTb), providing a versatile framework capable of characterizing equilibrium models across a wide spectrum of alternative semantics for extensions of ASP with linear constraints. We apply this framework to the setting of difference constraints, focusing on the semantic characterization of clingo[DL]. Central to our approach is the formalization of foundedness for numeric variables. By investigating how different hybrid systems - such as clingo[DL], clingcon, and flingo - justify constraint atoms, we uncover the semantic roots of their varying behaviors. This investigation results in a single, consistent framework that not only formalizes the foundations of current systems like clingo[DL] but also facilitates the rigorous study of program simplifications and the future integration of diverse semantic principles.

AI.title_translation: 带差分约束回答集编程的界限建立语义：初步报告
AI.tldr: 提出了基于多排序HTb逻辑的统一框架，为带线性/差分约束的回答集编程（ASP）求解器提供了一致的语义基础。

AI.summary: 本文针对带线性与差分约束的回答集编程（ASP）缺乏统一逻辑基础的问题，提出了多排序界限建立HT逻辑（HTb）框架。该框架形式化了数值变量的建立性，统一刻画了clingo[DL]、clingcon和flingo等混合求解器的语义，为分析不同系统行为根源、程序简化及语义融合提供了理论基础。
AI.keywords: 回答集编程, 差分约束, HTb逻辑, 混合求解器, 语义刻画
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于引入了多排序界限建立逻辑（HTb），填补了带线性约束的回答集编程（ASP）在统一逻辑语义基础方面的空白。其重要性在于揭示了不同混合求解器（如clingo[DL]、clingcon、flingo）行为差异的语义根源，为未来的程序简化与语义融合奠定了理论基础。局限在于该研究属于初步报告（Preliminary Report），在实际求解器性能评估和更广泛约束类型上的应用验证仍有待深化。

title: Hybrid MKNF with Classical Negation in the Rule Component
summary: Hybrid MKNF knowledge bases under the well-founded semantics integrate Description Logics with Logic Programming. However, they do not support classical negation in the rule component, limiting their ability to represent explicit negative knowledge. This limitation is particularly significant in safety-critical applications, where reasoning often requires explicit negative information rather than interpreting the absence of information as evidence of absence. To address this issue, we introduce an extension of Hybrid MKNF that supports classical negation in the rule component. We formally define the syntax and semantics of the extended language and present a general procedure for computing its well-founded model.

AI.title_translation: 规则组件中包含经典否定的混合 MKNF
AI.tldr: 本文扩展了混合 MKNF 知识库，使其规则组件支持经典否定，以增强对安全关键场景中显式否定知识的表示与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的良基语义下混合 MKNF 知识库在规则组件中不支持经典否定，限制了其表示显式否定知识的能力。在安全关键型应用中，推理往往需要显式的否定信息，而非仅仅将信息的缺失视为不存在。
AI.method: 引入了支持规则组件中包含经典否定的扩展混合 MKNF 语言；形式化定义了该扩展语言的语法与语义；并提出了用于计算其良基模型的通用程序。
AI.result: 成功定义了支持经典否定的混合 MKNF 扩展语言的语法和语义，并给出了计算其良基模型的通用计算方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的扩展框架成功弥补了混合 MKNF 无法表达显式否定规则的不足，为安全关键应用中的知识表示与推理提供了更有力的工具。
AI.translation: 良基语义下的混合 MKNF 知识库将描述逻辑与逻辑编程结合在一起。然而，它们不支持规则组件中的经典否定，从而限制了其表示显式否定知识的能力。这种局限性在安全关键型应用中尤为显著，因为在这些应用中，推理通常需要显式的否定信息，而不是将信息的缺失解释为不存在的证据。为了解决这一问题，我们引入了混合 MKNF 的扩展，该扩展支持规则组件中的经典否定。我们形式化定义了该扩展语言的语法和语义，并提供了一个计算其良基模型的通用程序。
AI.summary: 本文针对良基语义下混合 MKNF 知识库无法在规则中表示经典否定的问题，提出了一种新的扩展方案。作者定义了支持规则内经典否定的扩展语法和语义，并开发了用于计算其良基模型的通用程序，从而提升了在安全关键场景中表示和推理显式否定知识的能力。
AI.keywords: Hybrid MKNF, Classical Negation, Well-founded Semantics, Knowledge Representation
AI.comments:
创新性：该研究首次将经典否定引入到良基语义下的混合 MKNF 规则组件中，增强了系统的知识表达能力。
重要性：在安全关键型应用中，区分“显式否定”与“未获知（缺失信息）”至关重要，该工作为这类系统提供了更为严密且安全的理论与推理支撑。
局限性：摘要未提及计算其良基模型的程序的时间复杂度，以及在大规模实际知识库中的性能和可行性表现。

title: A New Well-Supported Semantics for Description Logic Programs
summary: Description logic programs are a powerful formalism for combining rules with ontologies. The well-supported semantics for description logic programs ensures that no answer sets rely on cyclic dependencies. Most popular semantics for logic programming have this property of well-supportedness. We recognize two limitations of the current well-supported semantics for DL programs: its increased computational complexity for the consistency problem and its lack of a reduct transformation characterization.  In this work, we present a new semantics which evaluates ontological atoms more strictly than the current semantics. This keeps the complexity of its consistency problem NP-complete, rather than increasing it to the second level of the polynomial hierarchy. Additionally, we identify a syntactic class of description logic programs for which our new semantics is equivalent to the current semantics. We characterize our semantics using a fixpoint operator and a reduct-based transformation. Our new semantics is a strict subset of the current well-supported semantics, so it maintains the prior notion  of well-supportedness while inducing its own stricter notion. We prefer our new notion of well-supportedness due to its similarities with logic programming.

AI.title_translation: 描述逻辑程序的一种新良好支持语义
AI.tldr: 本文为描述逻辑程序提出了一种新的良好支持语义，在降低一致性计算复杂度的同时提供了基于化简的理论刻画。
AI.motivation: 现有的描述逻辑程序（DL programs）良好支持语义存在两大局限：一是一致性问题的计算复杂度过高（上升至多项式层级的第二级），二是缺乏基于化简转换（reduct transformation）的理论刻画。
AI.method: 提出一种对本体原子（ontological atoms）评估更加严格的新语义；使用不动点算子（fixpoint operator）和基于化简的转换（reduct-based transformation）对该语义进行理论刻画；并识别出新旧语义完全等价的句法程序类。
AI.result: 新语义将一致性问题的复杂度维持在NP完全；它是现有良好支持语义的严格子集，既保留了原有的良好支持性，又引入了更严格的良好支持概念。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出的新良好支持语义不仅保留了良好支持性的核心优势，还降低了计算复杂度并提供了化简刻画，使其在理论性质上更接近经典逻辑编程，具有更优越的应用价值。
AI.translation: 描述逻辑程序是将规则与本体相结合的一种强大形式化方法。描述逻辑程序的良好支持语义确保了没有任何答案集依赖于循环依赖。逻辑编程中大多数流行的语义都具有这种良好支持性。我们认识到当前DL程序良好支持语义的两个局限性：其一致性问题的计算复杂度较高，以及缺乏化简转换刻画。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新语义，该语义比当前语义更严格地评估本体原子。这使其一致性问题的复杂度保持为NP完全，而不是增加到多项式层级的第二级。此外，我们确定了一类句法描述逻辑程序，在该类程序中我们的新语义与当前语义等价。我们使用不动点算子和基于化简的转换刻画了我们的语义。我们的新语义是当前良好支持语义的严格子集，因此它在保持先前良好支持概念的同时，引入了自身更严格的概念。由于其与逻辑编程的相似性，我们更倾向于我们新的良好支持概念。
AI.summary: 本文针对描述逻辑程序现存语义复杂度高及缺乏化简刻画的问题，提出了一种对本体原子评估更严格的新良好支持语义。该语义将一致性判定复杂度保持在NP完全，并利用不动点算子与基于化简的转换进行了系统性刻画。
AI.keywords: 描述逻辑程序, 良好支持语义, 计算复杂度, 化简转换, 不动点算子
AI.comments: 该研究针对描述逻辑程序（DL程序）当前语义计算复杂度高和缺乏化简刻画的痛点，提出了更为严格的新良好支持语义。其创新之处在于巧妙地控制了本体原子的评估严格度，成功将一致性问题的复杂度控制在NP完全，并补全了经典逻辑编程中非常关键的化简（Reduct）刻画，兼具理论价值与应用潜力。

title: chrKanren: Constraint Handling Rules in a Relational Language
comments: In Proceedings ICLP 2026, arXiv:2607.17707. The source code for chrKanren is available as free software at https://github.com/rvs314/chrKanren
summary: We present chrKanren, a dialect of the purely relational constraint logic programming language miniKanren which includes support for Constraint Handling Rules (CHR), a language for writing rule-based programs such as constraint solvers. We show how to integrate CHR's constraint propagation mechanism into the language of miniKanren search streams such that both processes remain complete. We also use chrKanren to illustrate novel applications of constraints in miniKanren, such as semantic unification of user-defined data structures and type-and-example-directed synthesis for relational interpreters in the style of MYTH.
comment: In Proceedings ICLP 2026, arXiv:2607.17707. The source code for chrKanren is available as free software at https://github.com/rvs314/chrKanren

title: Delayed Constraints in Narrowing for the Logic-Based Analyses of Real-Time Systems
summary: The formal analysis of real-time systems must address two dimensions of infiniteness: an unbounded number of agents and messages, and a potentially infinite state space induced by dense time. We present a novel narrowing-based verification method that deals with both dimensions. Our approach integrates (i) rewriting modulo SMT for symbolic representation of timing constraints, (ii) narrowing with logical variables to reason about systems with an unknown number of agents, and (iii) a constraint store over partially instantiated terms, in the style of constraint logic programming. We further introduce a folding mechanism that, under certain conditions, ensures termination of the symbolic analysis. The method has been implemented as an extension of the Maude rewriting engine. We evaluate the approach by verifying the correctness of a timed mutual exclusion protocol without imposing bounds on the number of participating processes. Moreover, we show that the framework uniformly supports the analysis of other real-time models, including parametric timed automata with unspecified components that our method can synthesize. Our results suggest that the proposed framework provides a sound and expressive basis for the symbolic verification of real-time rewrite theories.

AI.title_translation: 实时系统基于逻辑分析中的窄化延迟约束
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的基于窄化的验证方法，用于实时系统分析，它通过结合SMT重写、逻辑变量窄化和约束存储来处理无限数量的代理和消息以及无限时间状态空间，并通过折叠机制确保终止，并在Maude中实现，成功验证了无界进程的实时互斥协议，并支持其他实时模型分析。
AI.motivation: 形式化分析实时系统必须解决两个无限维度：无限制的代理和消息数量，以及由密集时间引起的潜在无限状态空间。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的基于窄化的验证方法，该方法整合了：(i) 模SMT重写用于时间约束的符号表示，(ii) 带逻辑变量的窄化用于推理未知数量代理的系统，以及(iii) 样式为约束逻辑编程的、在部分实例化项上的约束存储。此外，引入了一个折叠机制，在特定条件下确保符号分析的终止。
AI.result: 该方法已作为Maude重写引擎的扩展实现。通过验证无需对参与进程数量施加限制的定时互斥协议的正确性来评估了该方法。此外，表明该框架统一支持其他实时模型的分析，包括该方法可以合成的具有未指定组件的参数化定时自动机。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，所提出的框架为实时重写理论的符号验证提供了一个可靠且富有表现力的基础。
AI.translation: 实时系统的形式化分析必须解决两个无限维度：无限制的代理和消息数量，以及由密集时间引起的潜在无限状态空间。我们提出了一种新颖的基于窄化的验证方法，可以处理这两个维度。我们的方法整合了 (i) 模SMT重写用于时间约束的符号表示，(ii) 带逻辑变量的窄化用于推理未知数量代理的系统，以及 (iii) 样式为约束逻辑编程的、在部分实例化项上的约束存储。我们进一步引入了一个折叠机制，在特定条件下确保符号分析的终止。该方法已作为Maude重写引擎的扩展实现。我们通过验证无需对参与进程数量施加限制的定时互斥协议的正确性来评估了该方法。此外，我们表明该框架统一支持其他实时模型的分析，包括我们的方法可以合成的具有未指定组件的参数化定时自动机。我们的结果表明，所提出的框架为实时重写理论的符号验证提供了一个可靠且富有表现力的基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的基于窄化的实时系统验证方法，旨在解决无限代理和无限时间状态空间的问题。该方法结合了模SMT重写、带逻辑变量的窄化以及约束逻辑编程风格的约束存储，并通过折叠机制确保分析终止。该方法已在Maude中实现，并成功应用于验证无界进程的定时互斥协议，显示出其在符号验证实时重写理论方面的有效性和普适性。
AI.keywords: 实时系统, 窄化, 形式化验证, 符号分析, 延迟约束
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于其将多种技术（SMT重写、逻辑变量窄化、约束存储和折叠机制）集成到一个统一的框架中，以解决实时系统形式化分析中的双重无限性挑战。其在Maude中的实现和对无界进程协议的成功验证，展示了该方法在实际应用中的潜力，特别是其处理复杂实时系统并发性和时间约束的能力。

title: CaVE: A Constraint Storage Approach to Handling Integrity Constraints
summary: This paper presents Constraints as Verifiers and Emitters (CaVE), a constraint storage approach for handling integrity constraints in stableKanren. stableKanren is a normal logic-program solver based on extended unification and resolution. Integrity constraints control the outcomes of goals in normal logic programs, which is critical for non-monotonic reasoning. There is no resolution-based algorithm for handling integrity constraints that can be used in stableKanren. Therefore, we design Constraints as Verifiers and Emitters (CaVE), a constraint storage that works with resolution to support integrity constraints. We discuss variants of CaVE with respect to the integrity constraints, ranging from propositional to grounded and predicate versions. We implement CaVE using Scheme in stableKanren and show a series of example normal programs written in stableKanren with integrity constraints.

title: How Rules Represent Causal Knowledge: Causal Modeling with Probabilistic Logic Programming
summary:
Pearl famously argues that causal knowledge enables the prediction of intervention effects. By contrast, purely descriptive knowledge supports only conclusions drawn from observations. His theory of causality, however, is developed exclusively within Bayesian networks and causal models. Consequently, it is largely restricted to acyclic causal relationships, and transferring its ideas to other formalisms risks misinterpretation or inconsistency.
  This paper brings Pearl's approach to causality into probabilistic logic programming (PLP). To this end, such programs are aligned with philosophical foundations established in prior work that do not rely on temporal notions; that is, all relevant events are assumed to occur simultaneously. A formal causal semantics for these programs, together with a notion of intervention and an implementation, is proposed. It is shown that this semantics coincides with the P-log semantics for stratified ProbLog programs, while the two may differ in the non-stratified case and for other PLP formalisms.

AI.method: 本文将概率逻辑程序与不依赖时间概念（所有相关事件同时发生）的哲学基础对齐。在此基础上，提出了一种针对这些程序的正式因果语义，以及干预的概念和实现。

title: Explainability Framework for Policy-Aware Autonomous Agents
summary: In the field of Artificial Intelligence, an agent is a system which is able to autonomously make decisions in order to reach a desired goal. As these systems grow more prevalent in our day-to-day lives, there has been an increased need to add explainability features which can provide an account for an agent's behavior. We therefore propose a framework that outlines how to produce comprehensible explanations for policy-aware agents, or agents which have rule-enforcing policies incorporated in their decision-making framework. This framework is designed using insights from the social sciences on how to produce good explanations. It is implemented in the Answer Set Programming language while using Python to assist with information extraction and natural-language translation. Because these agents incur penalties when violating policies, we are able to leverage these penalties to detect undesirable events in scenarios that are counterfactual to the agents' original actions. This lends itself to creating contrastive explanations (e.g., "the agent performed this action because, had it not, undesirable event X would have occurred."), which formulate the core component for our explainability framework. The framework is evaluated using a survey wherein human participants provide feedback on our program-generated explanations.

title: Explainable Belief Harmonization under Dynamic Epistemic Partitions
summary: Existing approaches to multi-agent belief combination have established mature foundations for combining uncertain beliefs under common assumptions: consensus methods use iterative averaging, logic-based methods resolve conflicting knowledge bases, and epistemic logic analyzes agents' information states. Typically, these approaches assume that the structure determining what each agent can represent remains fixed. However, in many scenarios, agents gain or lose observational capacity during execution, and what was once admissible may become structurally impossible. This paper presents a formal framework for handling such runtime changes in epistemic partitions over continuous belief profiles. A hybrid approach exploits the advantages of answer set programming in elaboration tolerance, declarative integrity constraints, and explanations, with the numerical flexibility of Python. The framework applies to domains where agents operate at heterogeneous and possibly changing levels of resolution, and provides formal guarantees of admissibility preservation under refinement, unique mass-preserving repair under coarsening, and explanation completeness. Evaluation across 100 randomly generated topology changes confirms complete violation detection and explanation coverage.

title: Learning-based Seam Correspondence Reconstruction in Sewing Patterns
summary: Digital sewing patterns typically consist of disjoint 2D panels without explicit stitch annotations, making downstream 3D modeling reliant on labor-intensive expert specification. In this paper, we present a graph-based learning framework that reconstructs two-level stitching information, coarse panel connectivity and fine-grained seam correspondence, from 2D panel geometry alone. At the coarse level, panel connectivity is inferred by predicting panel semantics associated with anatomical body regions, enforcing consistency with body structure and garment design conventions. Based on the reconstructed panel graph, fine-grained seam correspondences between panel pairs are inferred by learning latent edge representations that jointly encode local seam geometry and global garment context through graph message passing. The resulting edge embeddings are subsequently decoded into detailed seam correspondences. Our method supports complex sewing-pattern topologies, including many-to-one correspondences, intra-panel seams, and curved seams. Experiments demonstrate high stitching accuracy and strong generalization across garment styles.

title: ARGON: A GNN-Empowered Compilation Framework for Scalable Neutral Atom Computing
summary:
Neutral atom quantum systems offer a promising pathway to large-scale quantum computing due to high qubit uniformity and flexible connectivity. To exploit this architecture, compilers must coordinate dynamic atom transport alongside highly parallel entangling gates. As circuits scale, the interplay between these operations becomes a system bottleneck, introducing denser logical interactions and longer temporal dependencies. Compilers must simultaneously satisfy rigid spatial constraints and complex movement schedules. Existing joint spatiotemporal compilation methods face an exponentially expanding search space, incurring substantial overheads or compromising fidelity as circuit size grows.
  In this work, we propose ARGON, a scalable compilation framework that introduces a spatiotemporal decoupling paradigm for neutral atom processors. Our key novelty is offloading static geometric conflict resolution to an offline phase, precomputing a library of hardware-certified, high-parallelism spatial layouts. To guide temporal routing, we deploy a Graph Neural Network (GNN) predictor to evaluate candidate layouts against deep temporal horizons, proactively evading downstream kinematic bottlenecks. Finally, a heuristic router translates the selected sequence into collision-free physical transport.
  Evaluations show ARGON completes compilation in under 10 seconds, delivering up to a >10^4x and 600x average speedup over state-of-the-art baselines. ARGON also minimizes routing decoherence and reduces Rydberg stages, improving execution fidelity by up to 10^2x on dense circuits.

title: ICAE-Bench: Evaluating Coding Agents as Interactive Project Builders
summary:
The recent emergence of vibe-coding workflows is changing what coding agents are expected to do. Instead of merely completing code under fully specified instructions, agents are increasingly expected to transform incomplete product intent into working software by combining various abilities including planning, requirement clarification, tool use, debugging, and repository-level construction. Yet existing benchmarks have not fully caught up with this shift, evaluating agents on static, fully specified tasks.
  In this paper, we introduce ICAE-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating coding agents under interactive project-building settings. The basic idea is to start from a fuzzy product requirement, simulating the dynamic paradigm with an automated User Agent. To make this setting both realistic and evaluable, ICAE-Bench introduces three key designs. First, to avoid the ambiguity of unconstrained fuzzy requirements, each task derives ambiguity from a precise real open-source repository with executable behavior. Second, to ensure high-quality and reproducible user simulation, ICAE-Bench grounds interaction through User Agent Data, allowing the User Agent to reveal hidden constraints without inventing new requirements or leaking implementation artifacts. Third, to evaluate open-ended repositories fairly, ICAE-Bench uses standardized black-box tests together with multi-dimensional diagnostics, including functional correctness, semantic and API similarity, structural fidelity, design quality, and interaction quality.

title: DART: A Degradation-Aware Recurrent Transformer for Archival Film Restoration
summary: Archival film restoration is a challenging problem because historical footage contains compound degradations such as scratches, dust, blur, noise, flicker, and photometric aging, while clean reference videos are unavailable. Existing video restoration methods largely treat these degradations implicitly, reconstructing frames without explicit knowledge of where damage occurs or how severe it is. We propose DART, a degradation-aware recurrent transformer for archival film restoration. DART predicts and propagates a soft defect mask through time, using it to guide temporal fusion and condition the restoration network on both damage location and severity. This makes the restoration process explicitly aware of film artifacts rather than relying only on reconstruction losses. Experiments on real archival benchmarks show that DART improves no-reference perceptual quality over prior restoration architectures while remaining compact and efficient, producing cleaner and more temporally consistent restorations of structured film damage.

title: Search Hardness-Aware LLM-Based Problem Formulation for Expensive Simulation-Driven Design
summary: Expensive simulation-driven design is widely used in engineering to identify requirement-satisfying designs with as few high-fidelity simulations as possible. Most existing efforts address this challenge by improving optimization algorithms under fixed formulations, yet the formulation itself shapes the search landscape by defining the objectives and constraints optimized by the solver. Recent LLM-based automatic problem formulation methods generate formulations from natural-language requirements, but they mainly focus on design-intent alignment and overlook whether the formulation induces an efficient search process. To address this limitation, we propose SHA-PF, a search hardness-aware LLM-based problem formulation framework. We find that a formulation is more likely to guide efficient search when it prioritizes rare samples with greater progress potential. Based on this finding, SHA-PF defines a formulation search objective guided by search hardness, scoring each candidate formulation according to the priority. SHA-PF then searches the formulation space under this objective through LLM-based generation, repair, and evolutionary refinement. Experiments on the real-world multi-objective benchmark and five expensive antenna design benchmarks show that the formulations discovered by SHA-PF require significantly fewer evaluations to reach the design requirements than other baselines.

title: Controlled Periodic Synchronization for Efficient Data-Parallel Training
comments: 20 pages, 16 figures. Submitted for peer review
summary: Data-parallel training relies on frequent gradient synchronization across workers. Standard DDP synchronizes gradients at every iteration, which is effective on fast local-area networks but increasingly sensitive to communication latency and network variability in geographically distributed environments. Periodic methods such as LocalSGD reduce synchronization frequency but rely mainly on parameter averaging, which may be insufficient when worker trajectories diverge. This paper studies synchronization frequency as a systems parameter for communication-constrained distributed training. We evaluate Controlled Periodic Data Parallelism (CPDP), a PyTorch-DDP-compatible strategy that alternates local updates with a reconciliation step combining gradient AllReduce and SlowMo parameter averaging. Experiments are conducted on Grid'5000 across intra-site clusters and a cross-site WAN deployment spanning Nancy and Sophia with 16.6 ms RTT. In the main fixed learning-rate setting of 0.1 on ResNet-50/CIFAR-100, CPDP achieves the highest peak test accuracy among the evaluated configurations. At K=2, CPDP improves over DDP by 2.28 percentage points but incurs additional wall-clock time. At K=4, CPDP improves over DDP by 2.44 percentage points while reducing average wall-clock time by 13.8%. Direct profiling shows that exposed synchronization time at K=4 is roughly half that of DDP, explaining the improved WAN accuracy-time trade-off. Additional experiments on ViT-S/CIFAR-100 and ResNet-50/TinyImageNet show that CPDP remains competitive with DDP and generally improves over LocalSGD. Overall, the results show that synchronization frequency is a practical control parameter for distributed training under communication constraints.

title: FORGE-plus: Force-Budgeted Recovery for Contact-Rich Assembly with a Frozen LLM Supervisor
summary:
Force-conditioned reinforcement learning (RL) enables tight-clearance assembly under a commanded force ceiling, but practical deployment requires determining an appropriate force limit for each object and recovering from insertion failures without exceeding it. We present a two-layer framework in which a frozen, text-only large language model (LLM) assigns a per-object force ceiling before execution and selects recovery maneuvers from a fixed action menu using compact textual force signatures. The LLM never controls force directly: a low-level controller enforces the force ceiling, the recovery policy cannot increase it, and the hidden breaking-force threshold is known only to the evaluator.
  We evaluate the framework on fragile bottle placement and 0.4 mm diametral-clearance gear insertion using two grippers (Robotiq 2F-140 and Franka Panda hand). A single policy passes 256/256 evaluation episodes on both fragile and robust objects without breakage, correctly predicts release timing, and completes a full table-pick-and-insert pipeline with a mean peak force of 5.4 N. Under injected in-grip slip, the force-signature recovery strategy resolves 40% and 64% of failures on the two grippers, whereas a press-harder baseline is either ineffective or causes frequent breakage. We also report negative results, including the failure of PPO to solve the task under strict force constraints and unsuccessful learned release strategies. All experiments are conducted in rigid-body simulation with hidden force-threshold breakage; no sim-to-real claim is made.

title: T-STAR: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Panoptic Scene Graph Generation in Satellite Video
summary: Structured understanding of satellite video is essential for advancing dynamic geospatial scene analysis from low-level perception to high-level cognition. To move beyond object-centric perception, this paper introduces spatio-temporal panoptic scene graph generation (TPSG) in satellite video as a new benchmark task. TPSG aims to generate a structured graph composed of a set of triplets <subject, relationship, object> with explicit temporal spans, thereby describing dynamic geospatial scenes by jointly modeling identity-consistent instance masks and spatio-temporal relationships among panoptic scene elements. However, there is still no dedicated dataset for TPSG in satellite video. Moreover, TPSG in satellite video is intrinsically challenging, as objects are often small and weakly textured, cross-frame association is easily disrupted by occlusion and background clutter, and relationship semantics are highly coupled with spatial structure and temporal evolution. Consequently, TPSG models developed for natural videos are not directly applicable to satellite video. This paper presents T-STAR, a large-scale benchmark dataset for TPSG in satellite video, comprising over 1.1 million instance masks and over 3.8 million spatio-temporal triplets across 39 fine-grained object categories and 70 fine-grained relationship categories. To enable TPSG in satellite video, we propose a unified framework to enhance cross-frame instance consistency and spatio-temporal relationship prediction. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significance of T-STAR and the effectiveness of the proposed framework, establishing a strong benchmark for future research on structured satellite video understanding. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/linlin-dev/T-STAR.

title: Progressive Cramming: Reliable Token Compression and What It Reveals
summary: Token cramming compresses sequences into learned embeddings with near-perfect reconstruction, but fixed token budgets and 99\% accuracy thresholds leave it unclear whether residual errors reflect optimization failures or fundamental limits. We introduce progressive cramming, which grows the target prefix token-by-token, stopping only when reconstruction is no longer achievable within a fixed optimization budget. Progressive trajectories occupy low-dimensional structure in embedding space. Prepending a crammed embedding causes a moderate but consistent accuracy drop on multiple-choice benchmarks even with the original prefix in context, and collapses capability almost entirely under generative evaluation. Causal attention-knockout interventions trace this degradation to the embedding's interactions in the model's early layers. These results position progressive cramming as a tool for studying compression limits and show that perfect reconstruction - achievable through brittle steering rather than transferable semantics - is insufficient for meaningful compression.

title: Logic Programming Semantics for Causal Processes
summary: Motivated by challenging modelling issues in the life sciences, we investigate the relationship between logic programming semantics and the eventual states of causal processes compatible with those logic programs. More precisely, we show that while stable models of positive logic programs correspond to the eventual states of processes commencing from a neutral state and continuing undisturbed indefinitely, supported models describe the eventual states reachable from arbitrary starting points. This also contributes to the discussion of the appropriate semantics for logic programming as a causal rule language, adding a temporal perspective to recent interpretations of the stable and supported model semantics from an explanatory viewpoint of causality.

title: Stokes-Informed Diffusion for Robust Linear Polarization Estimation
summary: Polarization cues benefit applications such as material detection and de-reflection, yet acquiring them typically requires dedicated hardware. This motivates us to estimate the linear polarization from a single RGB image. However, the task is inherently ill-posed, with the Angle of Polarization (AoP) becoming particularly unstable in weak polarization regions, where the polarimetric signal is overwhelmed by noise, leading to erratic angle estimates. To address these limitations, we propose GenPolar, a Stokes-informed diffusion framework grounded in the Mueller formalism from an intensity observation. Specifically, GenPolar predicts channel-wise linear Stokes components (S1,S2) from intensity S0, from which degree of linear polarization (DoLP) and AoP are analytically derived; AoP is further supervised with an observability-aware loss. In addition, to enable efficient and high-fidelity inference, we adopt a two-stage training strategy. Firstly, a multi-step conditional diffusion model is trained with a physics-based loss. Subsequently, we distill it into a one-step generator, which further supports stable Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) of the VAE encoder to mitigate domain-specific autoencoding bias. Extensive experiments across rotating-polarizer, division-of-focal-plane, and hybrid datasets demonstrate that GenPolar achieves state-of-the-art performance in both DoLP fidelity and AoP stability. Crucially, these improvements translate to significant and consistent gains in downstream applications, including material detection and de-reflection.

title: A Hyper-Reduced Neural Network-Augmented Semi-smooth Newton Method for Nonlinear Parametric Variational Inequalities
summary:
We propose a model order reduction framework for nonlinear parametrized variational inequalities arising in computational mechanics. The high-dimensional model is written in mixed primal-dual form with projection-based complementarity conditions, leading to nonlinear nonsmooth algebraic systems solved by a semi-smooth Newton method in primal-dual form. On this basis, reduced models are constructed by proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) of both primal and dual solution snapshots, and the resulting reduced systems are solved by semi-smooth Newton iterations in the reduced space.
  To address cases where low-dimensional linear spaces provide limited approximation efficiency, we introduce a neural-network-augmented reduced model. Two feedforward networks learn corrections in the truncated POD coordinates of the primal and dual variables, defining a nonlinear manifold approximation that is embedded directly in the semi-smooth Newton iterations. The online cost associated with high-dimensional residual evaluations is reduced through hyper-reduction, using a sparse cubature approach based on greedy nonnegative least squares. Particular attention is paid to the interaction between hyper-reduction and the learned nonlinear manifold.
  The proposed methodology is assessed on two nonlinear variational inequalities with distinct sources of nonlinearity: a two-dimensional obstacle problem with a cubic nonlinearity in the state equation, and a three-dimensional frictional contact problem in which the Coulomb law induces a nonlinear projection in the constraint equation. Numerical results compare the high-dimensional model, the linear reduced model, the neural-network-augmented reduced model, and their hyper-reduced variants, demonstrating accurate approximations with substantial reductions in online computational cost.

title: Detectors Learn the Wrong Thing: Shortcut-Resistant Adversarial Training Against Physically Realizable Attacks
summary: AI-enabled visual perception systems are increasingly deployed in intelligent transportation infrastructure and autonomous vehicle related applications. However, physically realizable adversarial appearances pose a significant reliability challenge for these safety-critical systems. Adversarial training is effective, but repeated co-occurrence between adversarial texture and positive person instances can cause detectors to treat the texture itself as evidence of object presence, forming a patch texture shortcut. The detector may then treat texture as evidence for the target, causing false detections on texture-only inputs and weakening cross attack generalisation. We propose InsCAT, an instance-level contrastive adversarial training framework that prevents detectors from using adversarial texture as an independent decision cue. SICA aligns adversarial person features with matched clean features and separates them from texture-only negatives, while ROPO and Guard maintain online attack pressure and coordinate training. We evaluate eight independently generated attack textures on rendered nuScenes, INRIAPerson, printed garments, and three detector families. InsCAT achieves an average attack AP of 82.3% on rendered nuScenes, exceeding the strongest baseline by 11.1 points.Relative to AT-Mix, texture FPR decreases from 46.9% to 7.3%. Physical tests yield an F1 score of 96.6% and an FPR of 1.8%. Consistent gains across separately trained detectors demonstrate applicability across architectures with direct inference. The findings show that robust physical detection depends on preserving target related evidence while preventing adversarial texture from becoming an independent decision cu

title: slang.gr as a Large-Scale Crowdsourced Resource for Non-Standard Greek
comments: Preprint of a paper accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 14th EETN Conference on Artificial Intelligence (SETN 2026)
summary: Slang is a central component of everyday language, reflecting linguistic creativity, social identity, and cultural change, yet its dy- namic and non-standard nature makes it difficult to model computationally. We present the first large-scale computational study of slang.gr, a crowdsourced lexicon of Greek non-standard language, combining lexical content, user-generated tags, and interaction data. To enable the systematic analysis, we map noisy folksonomic tags to a structured multi-layer taxonomy capturing both semantic categories and sociolinguistic metadata. Using this representation, we analyze the linguistic structure of Greek slang and the behavior of its contributor community. We find that slang is strongly centered on person-related and evaluative language, exhibits high morphological creativity, and is shaped by highly skewed participation with short user lifespans and overlapping communities. Building on these signals, we introduce a community-based confidence score for definitions that integrates user roles, interaction patterns, and moderation signals. Our results show that taxonomy-based representations improve interpretability while retaining meaningful aspects of behavioral structure, enabling a more structured and interpretable analysis of confidence signals. Overall, this work establishes slang.gr as a computational resource for non-standard Greek and provides a foundation for sociolinguistic NLP, bias analysis, and the study of informal language in LLMs.
