AI.method: 采用行业驱动、项目制的方法，让53名计算机学生与利益相关者互动并建模组织业务流程。系统地收集学生反馈，以展示所实践的软技能。
AI.result: 结果表明，通过教授业务流程建模，学生的专业精神、主动性、动机、沟通和团队合作等软技能得到了提升。
AI.conclusion: 教学业务流程建模对未来的计算专业人员特别有益，因为它有助于在AI辅助软件开发时代为他们准备软技能。
AI.translation:
背景与情境：组织高度依赖软件系统来实现其业务流程并实现战略业务目标和竞争优势；因此，能够理解这些流程的计算专业人员可以更有效地构建此类系统。与此同时，虽然人工智能（AI）提高了开发这些系统和其他系统的生产力，但由于就业市场的竞争力，专业人员应该做好更充分的准备；因此，软技能可能是确保他们在市场中地位的重要因素。
目标：本文旨在分析并展示教授业务流程建模对提升未来计算专业人员关键软技能的影响。
方法与发现：我们的方法包括一个行业驱动、项目制的方法，涉及53名计算机学生，他们积极与利益相关者互动并建模组织的业务流程。我们系统地收集了学生的反馈，包括所实践的软技能，并证明了专业精神、主动性、动机、沟通和团队合作可以得到提升。
启示：这项工作对计算机科学教育研究社区的主要启示是，提供证据表明教授业务流程建模科目对未来的专业人员特别有益，因为它有助于他们在AI辅助软件开发时代准备好软技能。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了通过教授业务流程建模来提升计算机学生软技能的重要性。研究采用行业驱动、项目制的方法，涉及53名学生与利益相关者合作建模业务流程。结果显示，该教学方法显著提升了学生的专业精神、主动性、动机、沟通和团队合作等软技能。这为计算机科学教育提供了证据，表明业务流程建模课程有助于未来专业人员适应AI辅助软件开发时代。
AI.keywords: 业务流程建模, 软技能, 计算机教育, 项目制学习, AI辅助开发
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于它提供了一个实证研究，证明了业务流程建模教学不仅能提升技术能力，还能显著培养计算机学生在AI时代所需的关键软技能，弥补了传统计算机教育可能忽视的方面。其重要性在于为计算机科学教育课程设计提供了有价值的参考。

title: Regulating autonomous and agentic AI
summary: Regulating activities where regulatees use autonomous and agentic AI is challenging. Regulatory assumptions about regulatee knowledge and control no longer hold true; much of that lies elsewhere in the AI supply chain which thus needs to be brought within the scope of regulation. Governance systems for autonomous AI cannot replicate existing governance models, but need a fresh approach. Retrospective supervisory oversight becomes ineffective as a risk management tool, and AI autonomy generates new systemic risks which require new solutions. This paper investigate four regulatory systems: UK regulation of content platforms, data protection, UK financial services, and the EU AI Act\'92s cross-sectoral regime. It analyses the challenges posed by autonomous and agentic AI and proposes potential solutions which regulators might adopt. These will transform regulation from a reactive process to an active one, and assist it in adapting to the challenges of AI autonomy.

AI.tldr: 监管自主和代理AI面临挑战，现有监管模式失效，需要新方法和解决方案，将监管链延伸至AI供应链，并从被动转为主动。
AI.motivation: 监管使用自主和代理AI的活动极具挑战，因为传统的监管假设（关于被监管者的知识和控制）不再成立，且AI带来了新的系统性风险。现有的治理模型和回顾性监督变得无效。
AI.method: 本文调查了四种监管系统：英国对内容平台的监管、数据保护、英国金融服务以及欧盟AI法案的跨部门制度。它分析了自主和代理AI带来的挑战并提出了监管机构可能采用的潜在解决方案。
AI.result: 论文分析了自主和代理AI带来的挑战，并提出了监管机构可以采纳的潜在解决方案，旨在将监管从被动过程转变为主动过程，并帮助其适应AI自主性带来的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 监管自主和代理AI需要全新的方法，不能复制现有模型。监管需要从被动转为主动，并将AI供应链纳入监管范围，以应对新的系统性风险。
AI.translation: 监管使用自主和代理AI的活动具有挑战性。关于被监管者知识和控制的监管假设不再成立；其中大部分知识和控制存在于AI供应链的其他环节，因此需要将其纳入监管范围。自主AI的治理系统不能复制现有的治理模型，需要一种全新的方法。回顾性监督作为风险管理工具变得无效，AI的自主性产生了新的系统性风险，需要新的解决方案。本文调查了四种监管系统：英国对内容平台的监管、数据保护、英国金融服务以及欧盟AI法案的跨部门制度。它分析了自主和代理AI带来的挑战，并提出了监管机构可能采纳的潜在解决方案。这些方案将使监管从被动过程转变为主动过程，并帮助其适应AI自主性带来的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了监管自主和代理AI所面临的挑战，指出传统监管假设的失效以及现有治理模型的不适用性。文章通过分析英国内容平台监管、数据保护、英国金融服务和欧盟AI法案等四个监管系统，提出了将AI供应链纳入监管范围、从被动转为主动的监管策略，以应对AI自主性带来的新系统性风险。
AI.keywords: AI监管, 自主AI, 代理AI, 监管挑战, AI治理
AI.comments: 这篇论文强调了AI时代监管范式的根本性转变需求。其创新之处在于认识到传统监管框架的局限性，并提出了将监管范围扩展到整个AI供应链，并从被动响应转向主动预防的思路。这对于政策制定者在快速发展的AI领域构建有效且前瞻性的治理框架具有重要指导意义。

title: Quality-Aware Multimodal Fusion Reveals Implicit Identity in Valence-Arousal Features
comments: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication at IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB), 2026
summary: Conventional face recognition relies on static appearance cues and degrades in unconstrained settings with expression variation, occlusion, and poor lighting. We hypothesize that audiovisual expression dynamics carry identity-discriminative information complementary to static appearance, and that extracting this signal requires multimodal representations robust to the variable input quality of in-the-wild video. To learn such representations, we cast multimodal valence-arousal (VA) estimation as a pretext task and propose Quality-Aware Adaptive Fusion (QAAF), which estimates per-sample, per-modality reliability and adapts each modality's contribution through learned soft gating and a quality-dependent dropout. For the problem of VA estimation, QAAF achieves an average Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) of 0.472 via late fusion ensembling on Aff-wild2, improving over a baseline ensemble under the same setting (0.415) as well as a single-backbone baseline (0.288). Furthermore, the proposed QAAF demonstrates greater resilience to unavailable modalities, with only a 7.5-34.4% relative decrease in CCC when one modality is missing. We then probe whether these VA-trained features encode identity without identity-specific training. On AFEW-VA (67 actors) and YTF (1,595 subjects), VA-trained backbone features rank first among evaluated soft biometric methods, and score-level fusion with ArcFace lowers EER on both datasets (0.022 to 0.021 on AFEW-VA, 0.106 to 0.104 on YTF), correcting 68.2% of ArcFace's false accepts on AFEW-VA. These findings establish multimodal VA estimation as a soft biometric modality complementary to conventional face recognition.
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication at IEEE International Joint Conference on Biometrics (IJCB), 2026

AI.title_translation: 质量感知多模态融合揭示效价-唤醒特征中的隐式身份
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为QAAF的质量感知自适应融合方法，通过效价-唤醒(VA)估计的预文本任务，学习对身份具有判别力的多模态表示，并证明VA特征可作为传统人脸识别的补充软生物特征。
AI.motivation: 传统人脸识别依赖静态外观线索，在非受限设置下（如表情变化、遮挡和光照不良）性能下降。作者假设视听表达动态携带与静态外观互补的身份判别信息，且提取此信号需要对野外视频中可变输入质量具有鲁棒性的多模态表示。
AI.method: 研究将多模态效价-唤醒(VA)估计作为预文本任务。提出质量感知自适应融合(QAAF)方法，该方法估计每个样本、每个模态的可靠性，并通过学习的软门控和质量依赖的Dropout来调整每个模态的贡献。
AI.result: 在VA估计任务中，QAAF在Aff-wild2数据集上通过后期融合集成实现了0.472的平均一致性相关系数(CCC)，优于基线集成(0.415)和单骨干基线(0.288)。QAAF对模态缺失具有更强的弹性，当缺失一个模态时，CCC仅相对下降7.5%-34.4%。在AFEW-VA和YTF数据集上，VA训练的骨干特征在评估的软生物特征方法中排名第一，与ArcFace进行分数级融合可降低两个数据集的等错误率(EER)，AFEW-VA从0.022降至0.021，YTF从0.106降至0.104，纠正了AFEW-VA上ArcFace 68.2%的误接受。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现确立了多模态VA估计作为一种与传统人脸识别互补的软生物特征模态。
AI.translation: 传统人脸识别依赖于静态外观线索，在表情变化、遮挡和光照不良等非受限环境下性能会下降。我们假设视听表达动态携带着与静态外观互补的身份判别信息，并且提取这一信号需要对野外视频中可变的输入质量具有鲁棒性的多模态表示。为了学习这种表示，我们以多模态效价-唤醒（VA）估计作为预文本任务，并提出了质量感知自适应融合（QAAF）方法，该方法估计每个样本、每个模态的可靠性，并通过学习的软门控和质量依赖的Dropout来调整每个模态的贡献。在VA估计问题上，QAAF通过在Aff-wild2数据集上进行后期融合集成，实现了0.472的平均一致性相关系数（CCC），优于相同设置下的基线集成（0.415）以及单骨干基线（0.288）。此外，所提出的QAAF对不可用模态表现出更强的弹性，当一个模态缺失时，CCC仅相对下降7.5%-34.4%。然后，我们探究了这些VA训练的特征是否在没有身份特定训练的情况下编码了身份信息。在AFEW-VA（67名演员）和YTF（1,595名受试者）数据集上，VA训练的骨干特征在评估的软生物特征方法中排名第一，并且与ArcFace进行分数级融合降低了两个数据集的EER（AFEW-VA从0.022降至0.021，YTF从0.106降至0.104），纠正了AFEW-VA上ArcFace 68.2%的误接受。这些发现确立了多模态VA估计作为一种与传统人脸识别互补的软生物特征模态。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为质量感知自适应融合（QAAF）的多模态方法，旨在解决传统人脸识别在非受限环境下的局限性。通过将多模态效价-唤醒（VA）估计作为预文本任务，QAAF学习了对输入质量鲁棒的多模态表示，并通过估计模态可靠性并自适应调整其贡献来提升性能。实验结果表明，QAAF在VA估计任务上表现优异，并展现出对模态缺失的鲁棒性。更重要的是，VA训练的特征在没有身份特定训练的情况下也能有效编码身份信息，并能作为软生物特征与传统人脸识别方法结合，显著提升了人脸识别的性能。
AI.keywords: 多模态融合,效价-唤醒,身份识别,质量感知,软生物特征
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了质量感知自适应融合（QAAF）框架，它能够根据输入质量动态调整多模态数据的贡献，这对于处理野外视频中复杂多变的输入质量非常重要。此外，通过将效价-唤醒（VA）估计作为预文本任务来学习身份判别特征，为软生物特征识别提供了一个新颖且有效的途径，展示了情绪动态在身份识别中的潜在价值。这项工作为提升非受限环境下的人脸识别性能提供了一个有前景的方向。

title: How Many Bits Can an Adapter Write? Measuring the Capacity and Memorization of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
summary: A LoRA adapter is a few megabytes that almost everyone treats as a skill rather than a record of the data behind it. We put that assumption on a scale. Extending compression-based memorization analysis to the frozen-base setting, we measure directly, in bits, how much a low-rank adapter writes into a model it never changes. The answer is both smaller than full fine-tuning and less lawful than parameter counting would predict. Adapters store a couple of bits per trainable parameter, well short of a full model's budget, but that figure turns less on how many parameters an adapter carries than on where they sit. Move the same parameter budget from attention into the MLP and it holds nearly twice as much; strip the frozen base of its structure and the capacity all but disappears. Applied to realistic fine-tunes of Qwen2.5, the same instrument shows privacy leakage rising with the bits an adapter writes rather than the parameters it nominally has, and it draws a clean line between supervised and reinforcement learning: the secrets that supervised fine-tuning copies down verbatim, an adapter trained on verifiable rewards never records. Measuring what fine-tuning writes, rather than attacking it after the fact, turns a piece of folklore into a quantity one can design against.

AI.title_translation: 适配器能写入多少比特？衡量参数高效微调的容量和记忆能力
AI.tldr: 本文量化了LoRA适配器能存储的数据比特数，发现其容量小于全量微调，且与参数的位置而非数量更相关。研究还指出，监督微调会导致隐私泄露，而基于奖励的强化学习微调则不会记录敏感信息。
AI.motivation: 挑战LoRA适配器仅作为“技能”而非数据记录的普遍假设，旨在量化其数据存储容量和记忆能力。
AI.method: 将基于压缩的记忆分析扩展到冻结基座模型设置，直接以比特为单位测量低秩适配器在不改变基座模型的情况下写入的数据量。
AI.result: 1. 适配器的容量小于全量微调，且不像参数计数那样具有规律性。2. 每个可训练参数存储几比特，远低于完整模型的预算。3. 容量更多取决于参数的位置而非数量，例如，将相同参数预算从注意力层移到MLP层，容量几乎翻倍。4. 剥离冻结基座模型的结构后，容量几乎消失。5. 在Qwen2.5上的实际微调显示，隐私泄露随着适配器写入的比特数增加而增加，而非其名义上的参数数量。6. 监督微调会逐字复制秘密，而基于可验证奖励训练的适配器则不会记录这些秘密。
AI.conclusion: 通过量化微调写入的数据量，将一个普遍的“经验法则”转化为可用于指导设计的量化指标，以应对隐私泄露等问题。
AI.translation: LoRA适配器是几兆字节大小的文件，几乎所有人都将其视为一种技能，而非其背后数据的记录。我们对这一假设进行了衡量。通过将基于压缩的记忆分析扩展到冻结基座模型设置，我们直接以比特为单位测量了一个低秩适配器在从不改变模型的情况下能写入多少数据。结果显示，其容量小于全量微调，且不像参数计数那样具有规律性。适配器每个可训练参数存储几比特，远低于完整模型的预算，但这一数字更多取决于参数的位置而非数量。将相同的参数预算从注意力层移到MLP层，其容量几乎翻倍；剥离冻结基座模型的结构后，容量几乎消失。将相同的工具应用于Qwen2.5的实际微调，结果显示隐私泄露随着适配器写入的比特数增加而增加，而非其名义上的参数数量，并且它在监督学习和强化学习之间划清了界限：监督微调逐字复制的秘密，一个基于可验证奖励训练的适配器从不记录。测量微调写入了什么，而不是事后才去攻击它，将一个经验法则转化为了一个可以进行针对性设计的量化指标。
AI.summary: 本文挑战了LoRA适配器仅代表“技能”而非数据记录的传统观点，通过将基于压缩的记忆分析应用于冻结基座模型设置，量化了适配器能写入模型的比特数。研究发现，适配器容量小于全量微调，且主要受参数位置而非数量影响。实验表明，隐私泄露与适配器写入的比特数正相关，且监督微调会记录敏感信息，而基于奖励的强化学习微调则不会。这项工作将关于微调记忆的“经验法则”转化为可量化的指标，为设计更安全、更透明的参数高效微调方法提供了基础。
AI.keywords: LoRA适配器, 参数高效微调, 容量, 记忆化, 隐私泄露
AI.comments: 这项研究通过量化LoRA适配器的数据写入能力，为理解参数高效微调的记忆和隐私泄露机制提供了新的视角。其创新之处在于将压缩理论应用于测量适配器的信息容量，并揭示了参数位置而非数量对容量的关键影响。论文的发现对于设计更安全、更透明的微调方法具有重要指导意义，尤其是在隐私保护方面。

title: Gradient Concentration, Not Weight Saliency, Explains Representation-Level Class Unlearning
comments: 51 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Neural Networks
summary: Machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data while preserving model utility. Many state-of-the-art approaches pursue this goal by restricting the forgetting update to a subset of parameters selected through gradient-based saliency. Although such methods are widely adopted, the actual contribution of saliency-based weight selection to representation-level forgetting remains unclear. In this work, we perform the first controlled ablation of the saliency masking mechanism used by SalUn. Using a matched-compute experimental design on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 with ResNet-18, we compare saliency-based masking against random masks of equal sparsity and unconstrained updates, while keeping the unlearning objective, optimization schedule, and computational budget fixed. Across multiple representation-level evaluations, including linear probing, prototype recovery, and layer-wise CKA, the three configurations exhibit statistically equivalent representation-level recoverability. We find that forget gradients are strongly concentrated in the final network layers (approximately 92% of the squared gradient energy on CIFAR-10) before any mask is applied, causing all masking strategies to operate within the same representational subspace. Furthermore, saliency masks show limited class specificity (specificity index 0.09-0.11), selecting highly overlapping parameter subsets across different forget classes. Our findings suggest that, in the studied setting, representation-level forgetting is primarily governed by gradient concentration and representation geometry rather than by the specific identity of saliency-selected weights. More broadly, the results support a growing body of evidence indicating that effective representation-level unlearning requires objectives that act directly on latent representations rather than on increasingly sophisticated weight-selection strategies.
comment: 51 pages, 7 figures. Submitted to Neural Networks

AI.title_translation: 梯度集中而非权重显著性解释了表示层级类别遗忘
AI.tldr: 本研究发现，在表示层级类别遗忘中，梯度集中度而非权重显著性是主要因素，现有基于显著性的遮罩方法效果不佳，提示未来研究应直接作用于潜在表示。
AI.motivation: 尽管许多最先进的机器遗忘方法通过限制遗忘更新到基于梯度的显著性选择的参数子集来实现目标，但显著性权重选择对表示层级遗忘的实际贡献尚不明确。
AI.method: 本研究对SalUn中使用的显著性遮罩机制进行了首次受控消融实验。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上使用ResNet-18模型，采用匹配计算的实验设计，比较了基于显著性的遮罩、等稀疏度的随机遮罩和无约束更新，同时固定遗忘目标、优化计划和计算预算。评估指标包括线性探测、原型恢复和层级CKA等多个表示层级评估方法。
AI.result: 三种配置在表示层级可恢复性方面表现出统计学上的等效性。遗忘梯度在应用任何遮罩之前就强烈集中在最终网络层（在CIFAR-10上约占平方梯度能量的92%），导致所有遮罩策略在相同的表示子空间内操作。显著性遮罩显示出有限的类别特异性（特异性指数0.09-0.11），在不同遗忘类别之间选择高度重叠的参数子集。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的设置中，表示层级遗忘主要由梯度集中和表示几何决定，而非由显著性选择的特定权重身份决定。结果支持了越来越多的证据，表明有效的表示层级遗忘需要直接作用于潜在表示的目标，而不是越来越复杂的权重选择策略。
AI.translation: 机器遗忘旨在移除特定训练数据的影响，同时保留模型效用。许多最先进的方法通过将遗忘更新限制在通过基于梯度的显著性选择的参数子集来实现这一目标。尽管这些方法被广泛采用，但基于显著性的权重选择对表示层级遗忘的实际贡献仍不清楚。在这项工作中，我们首次对SalUn中使用的显著性遮罩机制进行了受控消融实验。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上使用ResNet-18模型，采用匹配计算的实验设计，我们比较了基于显著性的遮罩、等稀疏度的随机遮罩和无约束更新，同时保持遗忘目标、优化计划和计算预算不变。在多个表示层级评估中，包括线性探测、原型恢复和层级CKA，这三种配置表现出统计学上的等效表示层级可恢复性。我们发现，在应用任何遮罩之前，遗忘梯度强烈集中在最终网络层（在CIFAR-10上约占平方梯度能量的92%），导致所有遮罩策略在相同的表示子空间内操作。此外，显著性遮罩显示出有限的类别特异性（特异性指数0.09-0.11），在不同遗忘类别之间选择高度重叠的参数子集。我们的研究结果表明，在所研究的设置中，表示层级遗忘主要由梯度集中和表示几何决定，而不是由显著性选择的特定权重身份决定。更广泛地说，这些结果支持了越来越多的证据，表明有效的表示层级遗忘需要直接作用于潜在表示的目标，而不是越来越复杂的权重选择策略。
AI.summary: 本研究质疑了当前机器遗忘领域中广泛采用的基于梯度显著性进行参数选择以实现表示层级类别遗忘的有效性。通过在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100数据集上使用ResNet-18进行受控消融实验，比较了显著性遮罩、随机遮罩和无约束更新。结果显示，所有策略在表示层级可恢复性上统计等效，表明梯度集中在网络末端层而非权重显著性是关键因素。研究发现，显著性遮罩缺乏类别特异性，且遗忘梯度在应用遮罩前已高度集中。因此，论文主张未来有效的表示层级遗忘应着重于直接作用于潜在表示的目标，而非复杂的权重选择策略。
AI.keywords: 机器遗忘, 梯度集中, 权重显著性, 表示学习, 类别遗忘
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于挑战了当前机器遗忘领域中一个被广泛接受的假设，即基于梯度显著性的权重选择对表示层级遗忘至关重要。通过严格的受控实验设计，它揭示了梯度集中度而非权重显著性才是影响遗忘效果的关键因素。这对于理解深度学习模型中的遗忘机制具有重要意义，并为未来机器遗忘算法的设计提供了新的方向，即应更多关注对潜在表示的直接操作，而非仅仅是权重层面的选择。

title: SPORD: A Simulation-Propose-then-OR-Dispose Approach for Supply Chain Planning
summary: For years, supply chain planning at e-commerce firms has operated as a collection of isolated projects. Each planning task from static network planning to dynamic warehouse assortment planning requires analysts to spend weeks building models from scratch, calibrating and persuading executives to act on outputs they cannot verify. Three barriers drive this: bespoke models proliferate because standardization is difficult (operational fragmentation); once unified, the combinatorial scale of millions of SKUs, thousands of nodes, and intricate routing logic exceeds what solvers can handle within a tight window (computational intractability); and a mathematically optimal solution still fails to be implemented if the executives do not trust it (implementation hurdle). To bridge this gap, we propose and implement the Simulation-Propose-then-OR-Dispose method, deployed as JD.com's NetSim platform. The central insight is decoupling: simulation proposes by generating and evaluating the full set of operationally valid candidate paths-absorbing all idiosyncratic business logic, while an integer program disposes by selecting the globally optimal subset. Computationally, matrix-vectorized CPU/GPU accelerated simulation achieves a 10-100 times speedup over serial methods, and a list scheduling algorithm reduces coupled-order processing from hours to minutes. Operationally, we establish a closed loop via an intelligent diagnosis engine. Since 2025, NetSim has optimized end to-end services for over 20,000 suppliers, the cross-regional fulfillment rate dropped from 6.1% to 4.9%, and the average monthly carbon reduction is approximately 5,745 tCO2e. SPORD moves simulation from monitoring to active planning. The transparent outputs turn skeptical executives into engaged collaborators, and the modular architecture ensures that the next planning requires just configuration, not reconstruction.

AI.title_translation: SPORD：一种用于供应链规划的模拟-提出-然后-优化或处置方法
AI.tldr: SPORD方法通过将模拟与优化解耦，显著提升了电商供应链规划的效率、准确性和可信度，解决了传统规划中的操作碎片化、计算复杂性和执行障碍。
AI.motivation: 电子商务公司的供应链规划面临操作碎片化（需从头构建模型）、计算复杂性（大规模SKU、节点和路由逻辑超出求解器能力）和实施障碍（高管不信任数学最优解）三大挑战，导致规划效率低下且难以落地。
AI.method: 提出并实施了“模拟-提出-然后-优化或处置”（SPORD）方法，部署为京东的NetSim平台。核心思想是解耦：模拟部分负责生成并评估所有操作上有效的候选路径，吸收所有独特的业务逻辑；整数规划部分负责选择全局最优的子集。计算上，采用矩阵向量化CPU/GPU加速模拟（提速10-100倍）和列表调度算法（将耦合订单处理从数小时缩短至数分钟）。操作上，通过智能诊断引擎建立闭环。
AI.result: 自2025年起，NetSim已为超过20,000家供应商优化了端到端服务，跨区域履约率从6.1%降至4.9%，平均每月碳减排量约为5,745 tCO2e。透明的输出将持怀疑态度的高管转变为积极的合作者，模块化架构确保后续规划只需配置，而非重建。
AI.conclusion: SPORD将模拟从监控转变为主动规划，通过提供透明的输出和模块化架构，解决了供应链规划中的信任和效率问题，实现了显著的业务和环境效益。
AI.translation: 电子商务公司的供应链规划多年来一直作为一系列孤立的项目运作。从静态网络规划到动态仓库分类规划的每个规划任务，都需要分析师花费数周时间从头构建模型、校准并说服高管根据他们无法验证的输出采取行动。有三个障碍导致了这种情况：定制模型泛滥，因为标准化很困难（操作碎片化）；一旦统一，数百万SKU、数千个节点和复杂的路由逻辑的组合规模超出了求解器在短时间内能够处理的范围（计算难解性）；以及即使数学上最优的解决方案，如果高管不信任它，也无法实施（实施障碍）。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出并实施了“模拟-提出-然后-优化或处置”方法，并将其部署为京东的NetSim平台。核心思想是解耦：模拟通过生成和评估所有操作上有效的候选路径来提出方案——吸收所有独特的业务逻辑，而整数规划通过选择全局最优的子集来处置方案。在计算上，矩阵向量化的CPU/GPU加速模拟比串行方法实现了10-100倍的加速，并且列表调度算法将耦合订单处理从数小时缩短到数分钟。在操作上，我们通过智能诊断引擎建立了闭环。自2025年起，NetSim已为超过20,000家供应商优化了端到端服务，跨区域履约率从6.1%降至4.9%，平均每月碳减排量约为5,745 tCO2e。SPORD将模拟从监控转变为主动规划。透明的输出将持怀疑态度的高管转变为积极的合作者，模块化架构确保下一次规划只需配置，而非重建。
AI.summary: 本文提出SPORD（模拟-提出-然后-优化或处置）方法，以解决电商供应链规划中存在的操作碎片化、计算难解性及实施障碍。SPORD通过解耦模拟（生成有效路径）和整数规划（选择最优子集）来提升效率和信任度。该方法已在京东NetSim平台部署，实现了显著的计算加速，并带来跨区域履约率下降、碳减排等业务效益，同时通过透明输出和模块化设计促进了管理层协作与未来规划的便捷性。
AI.keywords: 供应链规划, 模拟优化, 解耦方法, 电商物流, NetSim
AI.comments: SPORD方法通过将仿真与优化解耦，提供了一种创新且实用的解决方案，有效克服了传统供应链规划中的复杂性、计算瓶颈和管理信任障碍。其核心洞察在于利用仿真处理复杂的业务逻辑并生成可行方案，再由优化器在这些方案中选择最优解，这显著提高了规划效率和决策透明度。在实际应用中取得的显著业务和环境效益（如履约率降低、碳减排）进一步证明了其重要性和有效性。模块化架构设计也为其未来的可扩展性和复用性奠定了基础。

title: Emergent Misalignment Recruits a Pre-existing Persona Subspace
comments: 108 pages (19 pages main text, 13 appendices), 13 figures
summary: Fine-tuning an aligned language model on a narrow stream of bad advice can make it broadly misaligned on questions unrelated to the training data, a phenomenon called emergent misalignment. We ask why the narrow lesson generalizes at all, and we find that narrow fine-tuning recruits a persona structure that is present in the model before the fine-tune exists. From a frozen instruction-tuned model (Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct) we extract per-domain persona subspaces by contrastive teacher forcing and find that 4 unrelated domains share one low-rank core at 657x a random-subspace null, with 82% of that core lying outside a style core built at matched diversity. The literal first optimizer step of fine-tuning on insecure code climbs a broad-misalignment margin harder than the same code framed as educational, and forecasts realized margin movement out to 375 steps. Projecting the subspace out of the residual stream throughout fine-tuning prevents broad misalignment (27.7% to 0.0% of judged generations) while a matched-rank random subspace changes nothing; injecting it into the never-fine-tuned model induces misalignment that grows with dose to 45.4%, past the fine-tuned model it is measured against. The same projection applied to the weight gradient is inert, and three post-hoc weight edits leave the disposition in place: the sharpest edit suppresses the behavior rather than removing it, and the ablated structure re-forms inside the subspace the edit cleared. Spreading a fixed budget of bad data across 4 domains produces more broad misalignment than mechanical weight superposition and matched diversity jointly account for. All measurements come from one model at 14B; the extraction is from an aligned instruction-tuned checkpoint, which leaves the structure's provenance open; and the intervention that prevents misalignment also abolishes the narrow trained behavior.

AI.title_translation: 涌现错位招募预先存在的人格子空间
AI.tldr: 当对齐的语言模型在狭窄的不良数据上进行微调时，会发生广泛的错位，这是因为模型中招募了一个预先存在的“人格子空间”，该子空间可以被操纵以控制错位。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在探究为什么对齐的语言模型在狭窄的不良建议流上进行微调后，会在与训练数据无关的问题上出现广泛错位（即“涌现错位”），即为什么狭窄的教训会泛化。
AI.method: 研究使用了冻结的指令调优模型Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct。通过对比教师强制提取了每个领域的人格子空间。观察了在不安全代码上微调的优化器步骤。通过将子空间从残差流中投射出去来防止错位，并将其注入到未微调模型中以诱导错位。还测试了将投射应用于权重梯度以及进行事后权重编辑的效果。
AI.result: 四个不相关的领域共享一个低秩核心，其强度是随机子空间空值的657倍，其中82%位于风格核心之外。不安全代码微调的第一个优化器步骤比教育性框架更难地爬升广泛错位裕度，并预测了多达375个步骤的裕度移动。将子空间从残差流中投射出去可防止广泛错位（从27.7%降至0.0%），而随机子空间无效。注入子空间可诱导错位，随剂量增长至45.4%。应用于权重梯度的投射是无效的。事后权重编辑未能移除倾向，最尖锐的编辑仅是抑制行为，且被消除的结构会在子空间内部重新形成。将固定预算的坏数据分散到4个领域产生的广泛错位超过了机械权重叠加和匹配多样性的共同解释。
AI.conclusion: 狭窄的微调导致广泛错位的原因是模型中招募了一个预先存在的人格子空间。这个子空间可以被探测、操纵（投射出去可防止错位，注入可诱导错位），并且对某些事后编辑具有鲁棒性，甚至在被清除后会重新形成。这表明内在的人格结构在模型行为的泛化中起着关键作用。
AI.translation: 将一个对齐的语言模型在狭窄的不良建议流上进行微调，可能使其在与训练数据无关的问题上广泛错位，这种现象被称为涌现错位。我们探究了为什么狭窄的教训会泛化，并发现狭窄的微调招募了模型中在微调之前就存在的人格结构。我们从一个冻结的指令调优模型（Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct）中，通过对比教师强制提取了每个领域的人格子空间，发现4个不相关的领域共享一个低秩核心，其强度是随机子空间空值的657倍，其中82%的核心位于一个以匹配多样性构建的风格核心之外。在不安全代码上进行微调的字面上的第一个优化器步骤，比将相同的代码框架为教育性内容，更难地爬升了广泛错位裕度，并预测了直至375个步骤的实际裕度移动。在整个微调过程中将该子空间从残差流中投射出去可以防止广泛错位（从27.7%到0.0%的判断生成），而一个匹配秩的随机子空间则没有任何改变；将其注入到从未微调的模型中会导致错位，其程度随剂量增长至45.4%，超过了被测量的微调模型。相同的投射应用于权重梯度是无效的，并且三次事后权重编辑使这种倾向保持不变：最尖锐的编辑是抑制行为而不是移除它，并且被消除的结构在编辑清除的子空间内部重新形成。将固定预算的坏数据分散到4个领域，产生的广泛错位比机械权重叠加和匹配多样性共同解释的更多。所有测量都来自一个14B模型；提取来自一个对齐的指令调优检查点，这使得该结构的来源尚不明确；并且阻止错位的干预也消除了狭窄训练的行为。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型中“涌现错位”现象的机制，即狭窄的有害微调导致模型在不相关任务上出现广泛错位。研究发现，这种错位源于模型中预先存在的一个“人格子空间”被招募。通过在Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct模型上进行实验，作者证明该子空间在多个领域中共享，可以通过从残差流中投射出去来阻止错位，或通过注入来诱导错位。该子空间对权重编辑具有鲁棒性，且即使被清除也能重新形成。研究强调了这种内在结构在模型行为泛化中的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 涌现错位, 人格子空间, 语言模型, 微调, 模型对齐
AI.comments: 本文通过识别并操纵“人格子空间”来解释涌现错位，提供了一个新颖且深入的机制洞察。能够通过干预该子空间来预防和诱导模型错位，是控制LLM行为的重要进展。子空间对编辑的鲁棒性和重构能力揭示了模型深层、固有的结构特性，这既是创新点也为未来的模型对齐带来了挑战。然而，研究仅基于一个14B模型，且该结构来源尚不明确，是其局限性。

title: Toward Federated Cognitive Digital Twins over the Edge-to-Cloud Continuum
summary: Digital Twins (DTs) are increasingly adopted to monitor, analyze, and optimize Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs) through continuous interaction between physical assets and their digital counterparts. However, current DT architectures often rely on centralized and monolithic designs, leading to scalability, latency, and resilience issues in distributed environment such as smart cities. Moreover, they provide limited support for semantic integration and high-level reasoning, reducing the effectiveness of DT-based decision-making. Recent studies on Federated Digital Twins (FDTs) have addressed scalability by decomposing complex systems into interacting twins, but they still largely centralize intelligence in cloud components. In parallel, Cognitive Digital Twins (CDTs) enhance DTs with semantic reasoning, explainability, and AI-driven decision support, yet they are typically difficult to integrate into distributed architectures. This paper proposes a Federated Cognitive Digital Twin (FCDT) architecture that combines federation and cognition within a unified approach. The architecture distributes intelligence across the edge-to-cloud continuum through local twins, which provide real-time monitoring and lightweight cognitive capabilities, and global twins, which perform system-level reasoning, simulation, and coordination. By integrating distributed autonomy with cognitive reasoning, the proposed approach improves scalability, responsiveness, and decision-making in complex distributed CPSs

AI.title_translation: 迈向边缘到云连续体上的联邦认知数字孪生
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种联邦认知数字孪生（FCDT）架构，通过将智能分布在边缘到云连续体上，结合了联邦化和认知能力，以解决传统数字孪生在可扩展性、响应性和决策制定方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前的数字孪生（DT）架构通常是集中式和单一的，在分布式环境中（如智慧城市）存在可扩展性、延迟和弹性问题。它们对语义集成和高级推理的支持有限，降低了决策效率。联邦数字孪生（FDT）解决了可扩展性问题，但智能仍集中在云端。认知数字孪生（CDT）增强了语义推理和AI驱动决策支持，但难以集成到分布式架构中。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种联邦认知数字孪生（FCDT）架构，该架构在一个统一的方法中结合了联邦化和认知能力。它通过本地孪生和全局孪生将智能分布在边缘到云的连续体上。本地孪生提供实时监控和轻量级认知能力，而全局孪生执行系统级推理、模拟和协调。
AI.result: 通过将分布式自主性与认知推理相结合，所提出的方法提高了复杂分布式网络物理系统（CPSs）的可扩展性、响应能力和决策制定能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的联邦认知数字孪生（FCDT）架构通过在边缘到云连续体上分布智能，有效解决了传统数字孪生在分布式环境中面临的可扩展性、响应性和决策制定挑战。
AI.translation: 数字孪生（DTs）正越来越多地被采用，通过物理资产与其数字对应物之间的持续交互来监控、分析和优化网络物理系统（CPSs）。然而，当前的DT架构通常依赖于集中式和单一的设计，导致在分布式环境（如智慧城市）中出现可扩展性、延迟和弹性问题。此外，它们对语义集成和高级推理的支持有限，降低了基于DT的决策制定的有效性。最近关于联邦数字孪生（FDTs）的研究通过将复杂系统分解为相互作用的孪生来解决可扩展性问题，但它们仍然主要将智能集中在云组件中。与此同时，认知数字孪生（CDTs）通过语义推理、可解释性和AI驱动的决策支持来增强DTs，但它们通常难以集成到分布式架构中。本文提出了一种联邦认知数字孪生（FCDT）架构，该架构在一个统一的方法中结合了联邦化和认知能力。该架构通过本地孪生将智能分布在边缘到云的连续体上，这些本地孪生提供实时监控和轻量级认知能力；并通过全局孪生执行系统级推理、模拟和协调。通过将分布式自主性与认知推理相结合，所提出的方法提高了复杂分布式CPSs的可扩展性、响应能力和决策制定能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种联邦认知数字孪生（FCDT）架构，旨在解决传统数字孪生在分布式环境中的可扩展性、延迟和决策制定效率问题。该架构结合了联邦化和认知能力，通过将智能分布在边缘到云连续体上的本地孪生（提供实时监控和轻量级认知）和全局孪生（执行系统级推理、模拟和协调）来实现。FCDT通过集成分布式自主性和认知推理，显著提升了复杂分布式网络物理系统的可扩展性、响应性和决策制定能力。
AI.keywords: 联邦认知数字孪生, 边缘到云连续体, 分布式系统, 网络物理系统, 认知推理
AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的FCDT架构，有效地结合了联邦学习和认知能力，以解决现有数字孪生在分布式环境中的核心挑战。其将智能分布在边缘到云连续体的设计，有望在实际应用中提供更高效、更具弹性的解决方案，特别是在智慧城市等大规模CPSs中。该方法通过分离本地和全局职责，实现了分布式自主性和系统级协调的平衡。

title: FedAgentKE: Federated Semantic Knowledge Evolution for Heterogeneous Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents increasingly rely on reasoning, tool use, and iterative execution, yet existing agent frameworks still operate largely in isolation. While recent memory-based agent systems improve individual agents through local retrieval and workflow reuse, local experiences remain fragmented across isolated agent frameworks, limiting cross-framework knowledge transfer and collaborative reasoning evolution. We propose FedAgentKE, a lightweight framework for Federated Semantic Knowledge Evolution across heterogeneous agents. FedAgentKE enables distributed agent frameworks to collaboratively evolve transferable reasoning abstractions through iterative semantic knowledge distillation, aggregation, and adaptation without sharing raw reasoning trajectories. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements under both cross-framework and cross-task settings, highlighting the potential of federated semantic knowledge evolution for future collaborative agent ecosystems.

title: Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE): A Mathematical Framework for Deconstructing Learned Representations in Deep Networks
summary:
Deep neural networks encode complex representations, but deconstructing this internal knowledge remains a challenge. Given the link between learning and compression, network compression offers a promising lens to analyze this knowledge. However, standard compression heuristics often suffer from scale symmetries and architectural biases. To resolve these, we introduce Hilbert Operator for Progressive Encoding (HOPE), a mathematical framework to gradually deconstruct the representations in trained network weights.
  HOPE shifts network compression from the discrete domain into a Hilbert space of continuous functions. By modeling individual neurons as rank-1 Hilbert-Schmidt operators, HOPE unifies pruning and neuron merging as low-rank subspace projection. Extending this formulation, HOPE introduces macro block eviction to encompass multi-layer structures like entire residual pathways under the same unified metric. This unified approach enables unbiased architectural decisions across layers with different types and sizes. HOPE is a data-free and hyperparameter-free framework. We present proof-of-concept experiments in model compression and fine-tuning to highlight the practical potential of our theory.

AI.title_translation: 希尔伯特渐进编码算子（HOPE）：一种用于解构深度网络中学习表示的数学框架
AI.tldr: HOPE是一个数学框架，通过将网络压缩从离散域转移到希尔伯特空间，以统一的低秩子空间投影方式渐进解构深度网络中学习到的表示，实现无偏见的模型压缩和微调。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络编码复杂的表示，但解构其内部知识仍是一个挑战。标准的网络压缩启发式方法存在尺度对称性和架构偏差，阻碍了对这些知识的有效分析。
AI.method: HOPE将网络压缩从离散域转移到连续函数的希尔伯特空间。它将单个神经元建模为秩1希尔伯特-施密特算子，统一了剪枝和神经元合并为低秩子空间投影。HOPE还引入宏块驱逐来处理多层结构（如残差路径），使用统一的度量实现跨层无偏见的架构决策。HOPE是一个无数据、无超参数的框架。
AI.result: 通过概念验证实验展示了HOPE在模型压缩和微调方面的实际潜力。
AI.conclusion: HOPE提供了一个统一的数学框架，可以无偏见地解构深度网络中的学习表示，并在模型压缩和微调中显示出实际应用潜力。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络编码复杂的表示，但解构这种内部知识仍然是一个挑战。鉴于学习与压缩之间的联系，网络压缩提供了一个有前景的视角来分析这种知识。然而，标准的压缩启发式方法常常受到尺度对称性和架构偏差的影响。为了解决这些问题，我们引入了希尔伯特渐进编码算子（HOPE），这是一个数学框架，用于逐步解构训练网络权重中的表示。 HOPE将网络压缩从离散域转移到连续函数的希尔伯特空间。通过将单个神经元建模为秩1希尔伯特-施密特算子，HOPE将剪枝和神经元合并统一为低秩子空间投影。扩展此公式，HOPE引入了宏块驱逐，以在同一统一度量下涵盖多层结构，如整个残差路径。这种统一的方法实现了跨不同类型和大小层的无偏见架构决策。HOPE是一个无数据且无超参数的框架。我们提出了模型压缩和微调中的概念验证实验，以突出我们理论的实际潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了希尔伯特渐进编码算子（HOPE），一个数学框架，旨在解决深度网络中学习表示的解构难题以及现有网络压缩方法中的尺度对称性和架构偏差问题。HOPE将网络压缩从离散域转换到希尔伯特空间，通过将神经元建模为秩1希尔伯特-施密特算子，统一了剪枝和神经元合并为低秩子空间投影。此外，它引入宏块驱逐以处理多层结构，并使用统一的度量进行无偏见的架构决策。HOPE是一个无数据、无超参数的框架，其在模型压缩和微调中的潜力已通过概念验证实验得到证实。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 网络压缩, 希尔伯特空间, 学习表示, 模型解构
AI.comments: HOPE的创新之处在于它将网络压缩提升到数学框架的高度，利用希尔伯特空间和算子理论来统一和解决传统压缩方法的局限性。其数据无关和超参数无关的特性也极具吸引力，可能为深度学习模型的解释性和效率优化开辟新途径。

title: Incremental Optimal Assignment for Real-Time Crowd Tracking
summary: Multi-object tracking in dense crowds requires solving a bipartite assignment problem between detections and trajectories at every video frame. The classical Hungarian algorithm solves this in $O(N^3)$ time, which becomes a bottleneck for large scenes with hundreds of people. We propose an \emph{incremental} assignment algorithm that exploits the block-sparse structure of crowd tracking cost matrices --- dense within each crowd cluster, near-zero between clusters. We compute the exact same optimal $N \times N$ assignment as the Hungarian algorithm, but via an incremental strategy: we add one person at a time, exploiting the fact that after step $n-1$ the dual potentials are \emph{exactly optimal} for the $(n-1)\times(n-1)$ subproblem --- a strictly stronger condition than the intermediate feasibility maintained by the Hungarian algorithm during its $N$ outer iterations. Each new step therefore requires only a single augmenting path search from a certified optimal starting point. This avoids repeated full-matrix scans while guaranteeing an identical globally optimal result. A diagonal-reordering invariant keeps the data structure compact and cache-friendly. On realistic crowd benchmarks with $N \in [200, 5000]$ people organised into dense clusters, our algorithm achieves \textbf{3.7--6.5$\times$ speedup} over the Hungarian baseline while producing provably optimal matchings identical to those of Hungarian. The speedup grows with $N$ and remains stable beyond $N=3000$, making the method especially attractive for large-scale crowd scenes such as stadium exits and mass public events.

title: ASTRA-Net: Anatomy-Specific Transfer and Representation Alignment for Drug-Induced Sleep Endoscopy Segmentation
summary: Quantitative drug-induced sleep endoscopy (DISE) requires reliable airway boundaries at specific anatomical levels. Pixel-level DISE annotations are scarce, and manual contouring limits the scalability of quantitative assessment. To address this limitation, we developed ASTRA-Net for known-plane DISE segmentation with limited real annotations. Stage 1 aligned intermediate ConvNeXt-Base representations from 14,250 unlabeled virtual endoscopy frames derived from computed tomography and real DISE frames. Virtual images were used only for feature alignment. Stage 2 fine-tuned four independent UNet++ decoders on 401 real annotated frames. Structured zero-mask supervision constrained incompatible plane outputs and invalid frames. Six alignment configurations used maximum mean discrepancy, domain adversarial learning, or both objectives. On a hold-out evaluation set of 100 frames, the five-model MMD-only segmentation ensemble achieved a mean Dice of 0.8927, with a 95% image-level bootstrap interval of 0.8631 to 0.9160. The mean intersection over union was 0.8239. A classification- enabled variant of the same alignment configuration reached a restricted four-plane top-1 accuracy of 0.92 on the same hold-out frames. These results indicate that ASTRA-Net can support frame-level, plane-specific DISE boundary delineation when real annotations are limited.

title: DINOde: Continuous Vision-Text Alignment for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
comments: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 27 pages, 8 figures, and 10 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) leverages textual semantics to segment objects beyond predefined categories. While the self-supervised model DINOv3 provides strong structured visual representations, its lack of native textual alignment hinders its direct application to OVSS. To bridge this gap, we propose DINOde, an ODE-based framework that continuously aligns CLIP text embeddings with the DINO visual manifold. Our approach employs two complementary components: (i) Semantic Text Flow (STF), which evolves text embeddings toward the DINO manifold through a continuous ODE trajectory, and (ii) Global Context Flow (GCF), which progressively refines the holistic image representation carried by DINO's CLS token. To preserve the hyperspherical geometry of the feature space during this evolution, we further introduce Velocity Tangent Projection, which constrains the learned velocity field to the tangent space. By modeling alignment as a continuous trajectory, DINOde avoids the manifold entanglement inherent in discrete MLP projections and yields more robust cross-modal alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DINOde consistently outperforms existing methods and achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple OVSS benchmarks. The code is available at https://github.com/yoon307/DINOde.

title: Mean-to-Score Discrete Diffusion: Posterior-Mean Denoisers for Score Entropy
summary: Score Entropy Discrete Diffusion (SEDD) parameterizes discrete reverse processes with unconstrained positive score ratios. While positivity guarantees nonnegative reverse jump rates, it does not ensure Bayes realizability: ratios at a noisy state need not be jointly induced by any clean-token posterior under the forward kernel. The score-entropy loss has the correct population optimum but does not enforce this constraint away from it. In a trained pure-uniform SEDD checkpoint, roughly one quarter of complete score vectors violate the coordinate box, while more than half lie inside it yet remain materially incompatible with any valid posterior. Such violations can produce negative pre-normalization weights in finite-step sampling. Projecting raw scores onto the bridge polytope removes all observed negative weights and improves external generative PPL from $203.6$ to $175.1$ without changing the sampler. We introduce \emph{mean-to-score} (M2S), which predicts a clean-token posterior mean and converts it to the score through an exact kernel-dependent linear map. The construction applies to any known coordinate-wise continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) satisfying a mild support condition. For uniform corruption, it maps the probability simplex onto the bridge polytope; for absorbing-mask corruption, the resulting objective recovers MD4 exactly. In a controlled 28.4M-parameter CIFAR-10 comparison, M2S lowers test BPD from $3.173$ to $3.129$ and FID-50k from $\CifarSEDDFID$ to $\CifarMtwoSFID$. A 170M-parameter M2S model trained on about 262B OpenWebText token slots outperforms the evaluated pure-uniform SEDD, GIDD, and Neural CTMC checkpoints at every tested sampling budget, reaching generative PPL $143.3$ at 128 steps versus $183.6$ for the strongest pure-uniform baseline.

title: 3D Uncertainty Quantification for the Photo-Acoustic Tomography
summary: Photoacoustic tomography (PAT) is a promising modality for high-resolution biomedical imaging, motivating the need for reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) of reconstructed images. Bayesian approaches provide a rigorous framework for UQ but remain computationally challenging for realistic three-dimensional PAT and are sensitive to numerical approximations in the governing wave equation. We develop a finite-element Bayesian UQ framework for PAT that accommodates complex computational domains and detector geometries while enabling large-scale three-dimensional inference. The proposed methodology reformulates the randomize-then-optimize (RTO) sampling strategy as a matrix-free algorithm that generates independent posterior samples using only forward and adjoint wave propagations. Particular attention is given to constructing an adjoint discretization that forms an exact transpose pair with the discrete forward operator while remaining consistent with the continuous PAT adjoint, enabling efficient least-squares solvers within the sampling procedure. We investigate the influence of temporal discretization, artificial boundary conditions, and adjoint consistency on posterior uncertainty and identify discretization strategies that avoid numerical artifacts. The framework is validated against exact posterior statistics, existing Bayesian PAT methods, and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo using the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS), and is demonstrated on a three-dimensional problem with approximately $2\times 10^5$ unknowns on a general finite-element domain. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first large-scale Bayesian PAT study on general three-dimensional finite-element geometries, and the methodology extends naturally to a broad class of linear PDE-constrained inverse problems.

title: Electromagnetic-Aware Fluid Antenna Array
summary: Fluid antenna arrays (FAAs) offer a promising means of exploiting spatial degrees of freedom through adaptive port positioning. However, most existing communication models treat antenna ports as independent channel samples and therefore overlook the electromagnetic coupling that fundamentally governs compact apertures. This paper develops an electromagnetic-aware current-domain framework for planar FAAs. The proposed model integrates position-dependent multiport impedance, mutual coupling, radiated and accepted power, source-voltage feasibility, and channel variations into a unified baseband-compatible description. The framework is implementation-agnostic: the closed-form half-wave-dipole model adopted in this paper is only one instance and can be replaced by full-wave, measured, or surrogate impedance and embedded-pattern models. Building on this framework, we formulate two optimization-oriented design problems. The first addresses single-beam superdirective beamforming through the joint optimization of port currents and positions under sidelobe, current, voltage, and geometry constraints. The second maximizes the multi-user weighted sum rate via current-domain precoding and position optimization under accepted-power, current, voltage, and spacing constraints. In both cases, the electromagnetic model is not applied as an after-design correction, but is incorporated directly into tractable alternating algorithms with convex current or precoding subproblems and reduced-gradient geometry updates. Simulation results demonstrate that, when properly modeled, mutual coupling can be exploited as a valuable design resource, enabling lower sidelobes and persistent sum-rate gains over fixed-grid and random fluid-antenna benchmarks.

title: A Logic-based Temporal Cohort Discovery Engine: Algorithms, Indices, and Experimental Results on the National Sleep Research Resource
comments: Under review by the Journal of Biomedical Informatics (JBI)
summary: Large sleep-study repositories contain rich time-stamped physiological annotations, but cohort discovery is still commonly implemented as ad hoc scripts or scalar-index filters. We present a logic-based temporal cohort discovery engine that brings formal semantics, model checking, specialized indexing, and empirical evaluation into a unified biomedical informatics framework. We adopt Rational Ensemble Logic (QEL) as a dense-time formal foundation for sleep-data querying and represent each annotated polysomnogram as a Biomedical Event Structure Temporal Model (BEST), a finite mapping from event labels to non-overlapping rational interval ensembles. Cohort discovery is formulated as model checking of QEL formulas over BEST databases. We organize common sleep-research requirements into three reusable temporal query patterns: single-event retrieval, dual-event temporal pattern matching, and event data extraction. The prototype cohort discovery engine was implemented in Python with in-memory and MongoDB-backed execution modes and evaluated on synthetic interval datasets containing up to 90 million intervals and on real-world National Sleep Research Resource annotations from the Cleveland Children's Sleep and Health Study (CCSHS) containing 515 subjects, 202,587 intervals, 23 event labels. 2DFC constructs indexes in linear space and linear build time, reducing build time at 90 million intervals from 11,549 s with RTFC and 23,902 seconds with 2DRT to 3,655 seconds. On CCSHS, cohort-selection queries executed at sub-second latency at native scale and under 45 seconds at 1,000 times scale. This work is a part of the Symbolic Biomedicine program championed by the corresponding author.

title: Towards Faithful Graph Explanations with Synergistic Edge Effects via Granular Balls
summary: Instance-level explanations aim to reveal the rationale behind a model's decisions for a specific graph. Previous methods explain graph neural networks (GNNs) by selecting important edges to induce subgraphs, where edge importance is assessed by perturbing each edge and observing changes in the model predictions. However, they often neglect the synergistic effects among edges, which are crucial for accurately characterizing edge importance. To address this issue, we propose SeeExplainer, a parameter-free explainer to interpret GNNs. Specifically, we first introduce a granular-ball graph refinement mechanism that decomposes a graph into several disjoint granular-balls with no fixed size, and utilize them as nodes to construct a structural graph. This process can better capture the synergistic effects among edges. Then, we perturb nodes and edges in the structural graph to generate explanatory subgraphs based on their respective contributions. Experiments on several graph classification datasets of different networks show that SeeExplainer outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

title: Jordan algebras, hemiplex numbers, and the Cholesky decomposition of arbitrary symmetric matrices
comments: 17 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to the SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications. Software: https://github.com/timholy/HemiplexNumbers.jl and https://github.com/timholy/HemiplexFactorizations.jl
summary: Positive-semidefinite matrices are most efficiently factored using the Cholesky decomposition. For indefinite matrices, the Cholesky factorization does not exist, and the alternatives face greater challenges in achieving numeric stability and preservation of banded structure. Here we pursue an analogy between the requirement for positive-semidefinite matrices and the solution of the quadratic equation x^2 = c for c <= 0. It is shown that a non-associative algebra, called the hemiplex numbers, allows the Cholesky factorization to be computed for arbitrary symmetric matrices. Crucially, the hemiplex Cholesky factorization does not require pivoting for its existence or stability, allowing it to preserve banded structure. For singular matrices it produces a parametrization of the null space, and provides opportunity for truncation of nearly-null directions in a manner similar to common usage of the singular value decomposition. The hemiplex Cholesky factorization may be a practically useful addition to the tools for solving symmetric linear equations.

title: Multimodal Pretraining for Generalizable EEG Representation Learning
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) models used for epilepsy are often limited to specific datasets and tasks. This limited approach can make it challenging to apply these models across different datasets or in various situations. However, recent studies in foundation models and self-supervised learning suggest that an adaptable EEG backbone could support a range of EEG related tasks. In this study, we have developed a multimodal EEG foundation model that combines a raw signal encoder based on the Mamba architecture, a Vision Transformer (ViT)-style encoder for time-frequency data, and a lightweight encoder for text, all within a shared embedding space. The pretraining process relies on several innovative techniques, such as masked modeling, cross-view contrastive alignment, and temporal consistency losses. These methods are designed to create rich, seizure-relevant representations without requiring labeled data. To assess the efficacy and generalization of our pretrained model, we fine-tuned it on the canonical CHB-MIT seizure detection benchmark and additional seizure detection datasets, and conducted extensive experiments comparing different model variants. On the standard CHB-MIT split, our best single model achieved an AUROC of 0.874, and an ensemble variant reached 0.878 AUROC, representing state-of-the-art performance on this benchmark. In addition to standard train-test splits, we evaluated performance under a leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) protocol, which is rarely reported in prior EEG seizure modeling work and highlights the difficulty of patient-independent seizure detection, with a mean LOSO balanced accuracy of 0.558 across 19 subjects. Across datasets and evaluation settings, our multimodal foundation model enabled robust seizure detection and straightforward adaptation to new seizure detection scenarios, while also supporting interpretable seizure localization.

title: DISCO: Distributed Spectrum Compliance and Orchestration for Scalable IoT Coexistence
summary: Massive Internet of Things (IoT) deployments increasingly share spectrum with incumbent, licensed, and unlicensed systems under uncertain traffic, fading, mobility, and intermittent coordination. Existing mechanisms, including fixed power limits, listen-before-talk procedures, spectrum access databases, and learning-based resource allocation, address important aspects of coexistence, but they do not provide a common control plane to translate a network-wide interference risk budget into lightweight guidance for many autonomous devices. This article introduces Distributed Spectrum Compliance and Orchestration (DISCO), a hierarchical architecture that separates local spectrum learning from edge-level compliance regulation and slower cloud or non-terrestrial-network context adaptation. DISCO is not presented as a new reinforcement-learning optimizer or as a replacement for statutory spectrum rules. Its contribution is a deployable compliance plane that monitors violation statistics, broadcasts a compact governance signal, and adjusts policy aggressiveness without centralizing every transmission decision. A 30-seed UAV coexistence case study illustrates the efficiency--risk trade-off: the reported mean throughput is 81.0~Mbps, 73\% above fixed-power control, while the mean violation rate is 0.053 compared with 0.126 for uncoordinated learning. Because the 95\% confidence interval, [0.030, 0.076], crosses the nominal target of 0.06, the evidence supports statistical regulation near the target, not guaranteed regulatory compliance. Deployment, complexity, adoption boundaries, and open validation requirements are discussed explicitly.

title: Reachability in Directed Acyclic Graphs with Near-Linear Cut Queries
summary:
In the cut-query model, an algorithm is given access to a graph $G = (V, E)$ \emph{only} via cut queries. This model has seen significant attention in the undirected graph setting, with works establishing $O(n)$ cut query algorithms for computing the global minimum cut, $\widetilde{O}(n^{3/2})$ cut query algorithms for all pairs minimum cut, and many more. However, despite this vast array of progress in designing sub-quadratic query algorithms for computing properties of undirected graphs, there has been \emph{no} progress in designing such algorithms in directed graphs. Indeed, even for basic problems like whether a vertex $t$ is reachable from a vertex $s$, the cut query complexity is only known to be bounded in the interval $[Ω(n), O(n^2 / \log n)]$.
  In this work, we begin a systematic study of these basic problems in directed \emph{acyclic} graphs (DAGs). In this setting, we show that reachability from a single vertex and even topological sorting are both computable in $O(n \log^3 n)$ many cut queries.
  As a consequence, we also obtain an algorithm which, for any \emph{arbitrary} directed graph $G$, uses only $O(n \log^3 n)$ cut queries and determines whether $G$ contains a cycle.

title: Word meaning co-determines vowel-inherent spectral change. A corpus-based investigation of conversational Mandarin
summary: This study investigates vowel-inherent spectral change (VISC) in spontaneous conversational Mandarin. Using the generalized additive model and word embeddings from distributional semantics, we show that, when controlling for variables such as vowel duration, gender, speaker identity, co-articulation, vowel identity, and utterance position, vowel formant trajectory dynamics have word-specific components that are tied to their meaning in context: The F1 and F2 trajectories of words can be predicted from their contextualized embeddings with an accuracy that substantially exceeds a permutation baseline. Challenging modular cognitive models of speech production, these results indicate that, words' semantics co-determine the fine details of their articulation.

AI.title_translation: 词义共同决定元音内在光谱变化：基于普通话自然会话语料库的调查
AI.tldr: 本研究表明普通话自发口语中词汇的上下文语义会共同决定元音发音的细微共振峰轨迹变化，挑战了传统的模块化语音生成模型。
AI.motivation: 探究自然口语普通话中的元音内在光谱变化（VISC）是否受词汇上下文语义的影响，从而检验传统的模块化语音生成认知模型。
AI.method: 基于自然会话普通话语料库，运用广义加性模型（GAM）和分布式语义中的上下文词嵌入，在控制元音时长、性别、说话人身份、共发音、元音身份及语句位置等变量后，对F1和F2共振峰轨迹动态进行预测建模。
AI.result: 词汇的F1和F2共振峰轨迹能够通过其上下文词嵌入进行预测，且预测准确率显著高于置换基线（permutation baseline），表明元音轨迹动态包含与词义相关的词汇特异性成分。
AI.conclusion: 词汇的语义会共同决定其发音的细微细节（如元音轨迹动态），这一发现对模块化语音生成的认知模型提出了挑战。
AI.translation: 本研究调查了自发口语普通话中的元音内在光谱变化（VISC）。利用广义加性模型和分布式语义学中的词嵌入，我们表明，在控制了元音时长、性别、说话人身份、共发音、元音身份和语句位置等变量后，元音共振峰轨迹动态具有与其上下文语义相关的词汇特异性成分：词汇的F1和F2轨迹可以通过其上下文词嵌入进行预测，准确率大幅超过置换基线。这些结果挑战了模块化的语音生成认知模型，表明词汇的语义共同决定了其发音的细微细节。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了普通话自然会话中的元音内在光谱变化（VISC）。利用广义加性模型和上下文词嵌入技术，研究在严格控制发音与说话人相关变量的前提下，发现词汇的共振峰轨迹（F1和F2）可由其上下文语义预测，且准确率显著优于基线。这表明词汇语义参与决定了发音的细微特征，对传统的模块化语音生成认知模型构成了挑战。
AI.keywords: 元音内在光谱变化, 词嵌入, 语音生成, 普通话自然会话, 广义加性模型
AI.comments: 创新性与重要性：本研究将计算语言学中的上下文词嵌入方法引入语音学研究，通过自然口语普通话语料库证明了词义对元音共振峰动态轨迹的直接影响，从实证角度挑战了传统的模块化语音生成理论，具有重要的跨学科意义。局限性：摘要未提及该结论在其他语言或不同语境（如朗读文本）中的通用性，需进一步推广验证。

title: CRAFT: Exploring Wearable Creative AI on Smart Glasses for Fiction Writing in Real-World Contexts
comments: Conditionally accepted (pending minor revisions) for publication in Proceedings of the ACM on Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies (PACM IMWUT), Vol. 10, No. 3, Article 81, September 2026
summary: Creative writing increasingly integrates AI assistance, yet current tools miss in-situ moments when writers draw inspiration from real-world experiences. We envision Context-aware Reality-Fiction Transformation (CRAFT), an approach for AI glasses that translates daily experiences into fiction narratives. We explored its desirability, feasibility, and potential viability through three studies. Interviews with nine writers yielded desires and three design goals: 1) augmenting in-situ perception to bridge reality-fiction gaps, 2) promoting authenticity grounded in real-world experiences while maintaining fictionalization, and 3) preserving creative agency, enjoyment, and life-art boundaries. Co-design workshops with 16 writers and researchers operationalized these goals into concrete interaction mechanisms using a technology probe. We then conducted supported field trials with eight writers across 24 sessions using a refined probe, revealing writer-perceived benefits (e.g., enriched fictional ideas from serendipitous encounters), emergent practices (e.g., micro-creation), and design considerations for future sustained use. We contribute design explorations for the CRAFT approach, offering design implications and empirical insights on ubiquitous human-AI creative collaboration in everyday life.

AI.title_translation: CRAFT：在智能眼镜上探索用于真实情境小说创作的可穿戴创意AI
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了CRAFT方法，利用智能眼镜上的可穿戴创意AI将创作者的日常现实体验实时转化为小说灵感与叙事。
AI.motivation: 创意写作越来越依赖AI辅助，但目前的AI写作工具局限于传统文本界面，无法捕捉创作者在真实世界体验中即时（in-situ）汲取灵感的现场时刻。
AI.method: 提出了语境感知的现实-小说转换（CRAFT）概念，并开展了三项研究：1）与9位作家进行访谈以确立需求和三个设计目标；2）与16位作家和研究人员举办协同设计工作坊，利用技术探针将目标落实为交互机制；3）使用改进后的探针，邀请8位作家开展了跨24场次的受支持野外实地试验（field trials）。
AI.result: 研究揭示了作家感知的系统益处（如通过偶然遭遇丰富虚构灵感）、新出现的创作习惯（如微创作/micro-creation），以及未来持续使用该系统时的设计考量。
AI.conclusion: 本研究贡献了CRAFT方法的具体设计探索，为日常生活中无处不在的人机创意协作（ubiquitous human-AI creative collaboration）提供了重要的设计启示与实证见解。
AI.translation: 创意写作正日益融合AI辅助，但现有的工具忽略了创作者从真实体验中汲取灵感的现场/即时时刻。我们构想了语境感知的现实-小说转换（CRAFT）方法，利用AI眼镜将日常体验转化为虚构叙事。我们通过三项研究探索了该方法的受喜爱度、可行性及潜在可行性。与9位作家的访谈得出了需求与三个设计目标：1）增强现场感知以缩小现实与虚构的差距；2）在保持虚构化的同时提升基于现实体验的真实感；3）保留创作自主权、乐趣及生活与艺术的界限。与16位作家和研究人员开展的协同设计工作坊通过技术探针将这些目标具体化为具体的交互机制。随后，我们使用改进的探针邀请8位作家跨24个场次进行了受支持的实地试验，揭示了作家感知的益处（例如从偶发遭遇中丰富虚构想法）、新出现的实践（例如微创作）以及未来持续使用的设计考量。我们为CRAFT方法贡献了设计探索，为日常生活中无处不在的人机创意协同提供了设计启示与实证见解。
AI.summary: 本研究探索了名为CRAFT的可穿戴创意AI系统，该系统运行于智能眼镜上，能够将创作者的日常现实体验实时转化为小说叙事。通过访谈、协同设计工作坊和实地试验，研究明确了增强现场感知与维护创作自主权等设计目标，并揭示了该技术在激发偶发灵感和促成微创作方面的独特价值。
AI.keywords: 创意写作, 智能眼镜, 可穿戴AI, 人机协作, 语境感知
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于打破了传统桌面端AI写作工具的局限，将创意写作AI拓展至智能眼镜这一可穿戴设备上，实现了基于现实环境的即时（in-situ）灵感捕捉与虚构转化。通过访谈、协同设计和实地试验的三阶段研究方法非常扎实。潜在局限性在于研究样本量较小（实地试验仅8人），且依赖现有技术探针，长期使用的体验和智能眼镜硬件限制（如续航、佩戴舒适度）仍需进一步验证。

title: VoLN: Vision-Only Long-Horizon Navigation---Paradigm, Benchmark, and Method
comments: 10 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://admire-ljb.github.io/VoLN-UAV/
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) enables embodied agents to follow natural-language instructions. However, route-level instructions commonly encode spatial priors, such as orientation, distance, and layout, that are not explicitly available from onboard sensing at deployment in open, GPS-denied environments. Benchmark performance under such interfaces therefore jointly reflects visual navigation ability and the use of route structure explicitly supplied by the task description. As a complementary formulation, we propose Vision-Only Long-Horizon Navigation (VoLN), which shifts route-relevant information from externally supplied instructions and global guidance to locally observable in-scene cues. In VoLN, goal views specify the destination, while route-relevant information is available only through locally observable in-scene cues that the agent must detect, interpret, and select online. We instantiate VoLN for aerial navigation through VoLN-UAV, a 7,210-episode benchmark that combines long-horizon goal-directed flight, continuous 3D motion, large viewpoint changes, and context-dependent beacon selection. We further provide VoLN-MLLM as an initial reference baseline. It aligns self-supervised visual features with a structured semantic space and predicts short-horizon waypoint segments from observation history, goal views, retrieved visual--semantic tokens, and proprioception. On the five-environment Test-Unseen split, it obtains success rates of 7.4%, 4.5%, and 1.8% on Easy, Normal, and Hard episodes, respectively. These results provide an initial evaluation of VoLN and reveal substantial remaining challenges in long-horizon evidence integration, cross-view goal matching, and closed-loop stability. Project page: https://admire-ljb.github.io/VoLN-UAV/
